title: Exact Resonances Are Not Sufficient for Phonon Energy Diffusion
summary: Multi-phonon resonance conditions underpin kinetic theories of phonon transport and lattice thermalization. We show that exact resonance matching, nonzero interaction coefficients, and network connectivity do not guarantee persistent energy diffusion. Symmetry-enforced balance relations drive exact-resonant collision currents to nonthermal zero-flux states, producing kinetic arrest from individual resonant sets to connected networks. Complete energy spreading is sustained by quasi-resonances. The thermodynamic and weak-nonlinearity limits do not commute: the leading kinetic behavior is recovered in the former, whereas at fixed finite size the thermalization time diverges through higher-order crossovers as the nonlinearity vanishes. Exact-resonance existence and connectivity are therefore kinematic, not sufficient dynamical, criteria for phonon energy diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多声子共振条件虽被广泛认为是声子输运和晶格热化的动力学基础，但精确共振匹配、非零相互作用系数和网络连通性并不足以保证持续的能量扩散。对称性约束的平衡关系会使精确共振碰撞流驱动到非热零通量态，导致从单个共振集到连通网络的动力学停滞。真正维持完整能量扩散的是准共振。热力学极限和弱非线性极限不可交换，前者恢复主导动力学行为，而后者在固定有限尺寸下热化时间发散。
AI.motivation: 声子输运和晶格热化的动力学理论长期依赖多声子共振条件作为基础假设，但精确共振存在性和网络连通性是否足以保证能量扩散这一基本问题尚未被明确回答。
AI.method: 通过分析精确共振碰撞流的对称性平衡关系，研究共振网络中能量扩散的动力学行为，并对比精确共振与准共振的差异，考察热力学极限与弱非线性极限的不可交换性。
AI.result: 发现精确共振系统存在对称性强制的非热零通量态，导致动力学停滞；能量完全扩散只能由准共振维持。热力学极限与弱非线性极限不交换，弱非线性极限下有限系统热化时间通过高阶交叉发散。
AI.conclusion: 精确共振的存在性和连通性仅是运动学判据，而非声子能量扩散的充分动力学判据。这修正了传统共振理论对声子输运的认知基础。

title: Experimental access to molarity's blind spot in macroscopic assays
comment: 58 pages, 6 figures. Companion paper submitted simultaneously: "A concentration-independent paradigm rendering weak interactions inherently quantifiable" (M. Yoshimura et al.). Cross-references to the companion arXiv identifier will be added in v2
summary: Chemical kinetics has long inferred local molecular behaviour through the flask-and-molarity pairing, where well-mixed concentrations serve as the experimental readout. Yet many biological reactions occur in structured environments. Researchers have long recognized that concentration may not carry the same operational meaning in such environments, but even local concepts such as effective molarity usually translate local effects back into a single value with units of concentration. What has been missing is the complementary path: a bench-compatible way to make local structure an experimental variable, rather than only a correction to molarity. Here we show a chemistry-geometry crossover that the flask-and-molarity interface could not make visible. In the micromolar-or-weaker affinity regime, inhibition can switch sharply out of the familiar concentration-and-affinity mode: chemical binding strength no longer determines the response, and the shape of the target's local space does. A bench-compatible interface made this switch measurable by separating bulk dose from local geometry. This blind spot arose from the hidden premise that macroscopic pooling makes a structured local state readable as a single local concentration. The chemistry-geometry crossover breaks that premise: in a structured target environment, a macroscopic assay can remain sensitive to the probability distribution of local states, so collapsing that distribution to one concentration-valued number removes the geometric control axis from the readout. By preserving that axis in the experiment, the interface bypasses molarity's hidden bottleneck and provides a routine experimental route to remeasure and reinterpret molecular interactions in structured space.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了化学动力学中"烧瓶-摩尔浓度"范式在结构化环境中的根本局限，发现了一个"化学-几何交叉"现象：在微摩尔或更弱的亲和力区间，抑制反应不再由结合强度主导，而是由靶标局部空间的形状决定。作者提出并实现了一种实验接口，将宏观剂量与局部几何分离，使局部结构成为可操作的实验变量，而非仅是对摩尔浓度的修正。
AI.motivation: 传统化学动力学用"烧瓶与摩尔浓度"配对来推断局部分子行为，但许多生物学反应发生在结构化环境中。长期以来，研究人员认识到浓度在结构化环境中缺乏相同的操作意义，但即便有效摩尔浓度等局部概念，也仅将局部效应折算成单个浓度值。缺失的是让局部结构本身成为实验变量的路径——这是一个根本性的方法论盲区。
AI.method: 作者提出一种"化学-几何交叉"框架和与之配套的台式兼容实验接口。核心策略是将宏观剂量与局部几何分离：在实验中保持靶标的结构化微环境，同时区分批量给药浓度与局部几何作用，从而保留几何控制轴而非将其坍缩为单一浓度值。这种方法绕过了摩尔浓度背后的隐含瓶颈，使局部结构的概率分布而非均值成为可测量的读数。
AI.result: 研究发现，在微摩尔或更弱的亲和力区间，抑制反应会从传统的"浓度-亲和力"模式发生剧烈切换：化学结合强度不再决定响应，靶标局部空间的形状成为主导因素。这种切换在传统"烧瓶-摩尔浓度"界面下不可见，但通过分离批量剂量与局部几何的台式接口可以被清晰测量。宏观测定实际上对局部状态的概率分布保持敏感，坍缩该分布会消除几�何控制轴。
AI.conclusion: 该工作打破了"宏观混合使结构化局部状态可读为单一局部浓度"这一隐藏前提，证明在结构化靶标环境中，保留几何控制轴是必要的。通过提供一种日常化的实验路线来重新测量和解读结构化空间中的分子相互作用，为化学动力学打开了一个被摩尔浓度范式遮蔽的研究维度。

title: Tunable Skyrmions in a Topological Wigner Crystal
summary: In low density systems with strong interactions electrons are expected to crystallize into a Wigner solid. Recently, advances in two-dimensional systems where electrons carry Berry curvature have added a topological dimension to Wigner crystallization. Using a model for pseudospin interactions in a topological Wigner crystal, here we show that the competition between ferromagnetic Heisenberg exchange $J$ and the chiral interaction $γ$ on the triangular lattice stabilizes a zero-field skyrmion crystal whose density is continuously tunable through the ratio $γ/J$. The chiral interaction originates from finite Berry curvature in an underlying time-reversal broken Wigner crystal. In the continuum limit, the chiral interaction acts as a chemical potential for skyrmions, while higher-order gradient terms beyond the nonlinear sigma model select the skyrmion density. At large chiral coupling, we uncover a 24-site tetra-skyrmion crystal carrying four units of topological charge per magnetic unit cell, which becomes degenerate with four-sublattice tetrahedral order as $J \to 0$. We characterize the magnon structure for these phases and discuss the transition between the tunable skyrmion crystal to these states at large $γ/J$. Our results establish the phase diagram of ferromagnetic topological Wigner crystals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了拓扑维格纳晶体中的赝自旋相互作用，发现铁磁海森堡交换相互作用J与手性相互作用γ之间的竞争在三角晶格上稳定了一种零场斯格明子晶体，其密度可通过γ/J连续调控。在大手性耦合下，揭示了一个24位点四斯格明子晶体，每个磁原胞携带四个拓扑电荷单位。
AI.motivation: 低密度强相互作用电子系统中电子预期会结晶形成维格纳固体。近年来，二维系统中电子携带贝里曲率的进展为维格纳结晶增加了拓扑维度。作者希望探索拓扑维格纳晶体中赝自旋相互作用的竞争如何稳定新奇的自旋纹理相（如斯格明子晶体），并建立完整的相图。
AI.method: 使用赝自旋相互作用的拓扑维格纳晶体模型，在三角晶格上分析铁磁海森堡交换J与手性相互作用γ之间的竞争。采用连续极限分析，表明手性相互作用充当斯格明子的化学势，而超出非线性sigma模型的高阶梯度项选择斯格明子密度。通过解析和数值方法表征了这些相的磁振子结构。
AI.result: 发现手性相互作用稳定了密度连续可调的零场斯格明子晶体；在大手性耦合（γ）极限下，发现了24位点四斯格明子晶体相，每个磁原胞携带四个拓扑电荷单位，并在J→0极限下与四亚晶格四面体序简并；表征了这些相的磁振子结构并讨论了相变行为。
AI.conclusion: 建立了铁磁拓扑维格纳晶体的完整相图，展示了手性相互作用如何稳定可调的斯格明子晶体相，以及在高手性耦合下的四斯格明子晶体相，为拓扑维格纳晶体中自旋纹理的研究提供了理论基础。

title: Electrostatic Superlattices beyond 1:1 Stoichiometry
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. The Supporting Information file is uploaded as ancillary file
summary: Exotic nanoparticle superstructures can be accessed by harnessing nanoparticle softness and charge regulation, features often viewed as obstacles to structural control. Here, we show that regulated charge mismatch in polymer-grafted nanoparticles enables the assembly of high-stoichiometry cubic superlattices. By co-tuning grafting density, particle size, and bulk composition, we realize ionic-lattice analogues such as CaF2 and Th3P4, as well as single-component A3 and A7 superlattices without atomic counterparts. The A3 lattice has recently been identified theoretically as a photonic band-gap lattice. These phases emerge from a 1:1 "parent" lattice when local charge neutrality cannot be satisfied, driving either progressive interstitial filling or reorganization into a larger basis. For instance, the systematic occupation of ZnS tetrahedral sites yields CaF2, while ligand-swapping symmetry breaking converts CsCl into Th3P4. Upon heating, the assemblies exhibit reversible lattice contraction and pronounced negative thermal expansion. Furthermore, the energetic penalty for defects increases with nanoparticle size, facilitating the scalable production of high-quality, open superlattices for photonic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了通过调控聚合物接枝纳米粒子的可调节电荷失配，实现高化学计量比立方超晶格的自组装，包括CaF2、Th3P4离子晶格类似物，以及无原子对应物的A3和A7单组分超晶格。这些相从1:1"母体"晶格演化而来，伴随可逆的负热膨胀行为，且缺陷能垒随粒径增大而增加，有利于规模化生产光子学应用所需的高质量开放超晶格。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为纳米粒子的软度和电荷调控是结构控制的障碍，而本研究的动机是反转这一思路：将纳米粒子的软度和电荷调节能力转化为优势，利用"调控的电荷失配"来解锁传统方法难以获得的高化学计量比立方超晶格结构，特别是那些具有光子带隙潜力的新型晶格。
AI.method: 通过协同调控三个关键参数——接枝密度（grafTting density）、粒子尺寸（particle size）和体相组成（bulk composition）——在聚合物接枝纳米粒子体系中引入受控的电荷失配。利用局部电荷中性无法满足的物理约束，驱动结构从1:1"母体"晶格发生两类转变：渐进式间隙填充（如ZnS四面体位点系统占据形成CaF2）或重组为更大基元（如配体交换对称性破缺将CsCl转化为Th3P4）。
AI.result: 成功实现了多种高化学计量比超晶格的自组装：CaF2和Th3P4离子晶格类似物，以及无原子晶体对应物的A3和A7单组分超晶格（其中A3晶格已被理论预测为光子带隙晶格）。加热时组装体表现出可逆的晶格收缩和显著负热膨胀。还发现缺陷的能量惩罚随纳米粒子尺寸增大而增加，这一特性有利于高质量大尺寸超晶格的制备。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明纳米粒子的软度和电荷调节并非障碍，而是通往新型超结构的有力工具，开辟了利用"电荷失配"策略设计超越原子晶体结构空间的新型超晶格的道路，为光子晶体等应用提供了可规模化制备的高质量材料平台。

title: Epitaxial SiGeSn alloys for CMOS-compatible thermoelectric devices
summary: The integration of thermoelectric devices into mainstream microelectronic technological platform could be a major breakthrough in various fields within the \emph{so-called} Green-IT realm. In this article, the thermoelectric properties of heteroepitaxial SiGeSn alloys, a novel CMOS compatible material system, are evaluated to assess their possible application in thermoelectric devices. To this purpose, starting from the experimentally low lattice thermal conductivity of SiGeSn/Ge/Si layers of about $\sim$1-2 W/m$\cdot$K assessed by means of 3-$ω$ measurements, the figure of merits are calculated through the use of Boltzmann transport equation, taking into account the relevant inter-valley scattering processes, peculiar of this multi-valley material system. Values for the figure of merit $ZT$ exceeding $1$ have been obtained for both p- and n- type material at operating temperatures within the 300---400 K range, i.e. at a typical On-Chip temperatures. In this interval, the predicted power factor also features very competitive values of the order of 20 $\rm{μW/cm\cdot K^2}$. Our finding indicates that this new class of Si-based materials has extremely good prospects for real-world applications, and can further stimulate scientific investigation in this ambit.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了新型CMOS兼容材料SiGeSn合金的热电性能，通过3ω测量获得实验低晶格热导率（~1-2 W/m·K），并利用玻尔兹曼输运方程计算了考虑谷间散射的ZT值。研究发现p型和n型材料在300-400K（典型片上温度）范围内ZT值均超过1，功率因子达到~20 μW/cm·K²，表明该材料在热电设备中具有极好的应用前景。
AI.motivation: 将热电设备集成到主流微电子技术平台可能对绿色IT领域产生重大突破，因此需要评估新型CMOS兼容材料的热电性能，以确定其是否适合实际应用。
AI.method: 采用3-ω测量方法测定SiGeSn/Ge/Si层的实验低晶格热导率，然后通过玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）计算热电优值ZT，计算中考虑了该多谷材料系统特有的谷间散射过程。
AI.result: 在300-400K（典型片上温度）范围内，p型和n型材料的ZT值均超过1；功率因子达到约20 μW/cm·K²的竞争力水平。
AI.conclusion: 这种新型硅基材料在热电设备的实际应用方面具有极好的前景，可进一步推动该领域的研究。

title: Chaos and Diffusion in Twisted Bilayer Graphene
summary: We numerically analyze chaos and diffusion in experimentally-relevant models of twisted bilayer graphene. Our results indicate that finite systems at both commensurate and incommensurate rotation angles exhibit chaos. We compute the Thouless energy of the system at intermediate twist angles to further understand the diffusive processes associated with the chaotic nature of the spectrum. We find that the mean free path of the non-interacting electrons scales with the system size, which is consistent with diffusive processes caused by border-induced scattering. In summary, our results show the role of borders as a experimentally relevant single-particle scattering mechanism, which is much stronger than in single-layer graphene and induces chaos and diffusion regardless of the rotation angle and the lattice commensurability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值分析研究了扭转双层石墨烯（TBG）在实验相关模型中的混沌与扩散行为。研究发现，无论是公度还是非公度转角下，有限系统均表现出混沌现象。通过计算中间转角的Thouless能量，作者揭示了与频谱混沌性质相关的扩散过程。关键发现是：非相互作用电子的平均自由程随系统尺寸缩放，这与边界诱导散射导致的扩散过程一致。研究结论表明，边界作为实验相关的单粒子散射机制，其作用远强于单层石墨烯，且无论转角大小或晶格公度性如何，都能诱导混沌和扩散。
AI.motivation: 扭转双层石墨烯因其丰富的物理现象（如超导、关联绝缘态等）备受关注，但先前研究多聚焦于能带拓扑和强关联效应，对其单粒子输运性质中潜在的混沌与扩散行为关注不足。作者旨在揭示边界散射作为实验相关机制在TBG中的重要作用，并探讨其与转角及公度性的关系。
AI.method: 采用数值分析方法，对实验相关的扭转双层石墨烯模型进行混沌和扩散分析。具体包括：1）在公度和非公度转角下研究有限系统的混沌行为；2）计算中间转角的Thouless能量以理解频谱混沌相关的扩散过程；3）分析非相互作用电子的平均自由程与系统尺寸的标度关系。
AI.result: 1）有限系统在公度和非公度转角下均表现出混沌现象；2）平均自由程随系统尺寸线性缩放，符合边界诱导散射驱动的扩散过程特征；3）边界散射机制在TBG中远强于单层石墨烯，且与旋转角度和晶格公度性无关。
AI.conclusion: 边界散射是TBG中一个被低估但实验上非常重要的单粒子散射机制，它能够普遍地诱导混沌和扩散行为，不受转角大小和公度性的影响。这为理解TBG的输运性质提供了新的视角，可能对解释实验中观测到的某些异常行为具有重要意义。

title: Discrepancy between the H-Function and Entropy: Insights into the rigorously established Boltzmann equation for hard-sphere gases
summary: By investigating the origin of the evolutionary discrepancy between the H-function and entropy, we elucidate that the H-function fails to serve as a valid arrow-of-time criterion in the rigorously derived Boltzmann equation for the hard-sphere gas model under the Boltzmann-Grad limit.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究H函数与熵之间演化差异的根源，阐明在玻尔兹曼-格拉德极限下严格导出的硬球气体玻尔兹曼方程中，H函数不能作为有效的时间箭头判据。
AI.motivation: 探究H函数与熵在演化行为上的差异来源，质疑H函数作为时间箭头判据的有效性。
AI.method: 分析硬球气体模型在玻尔兹曼-格拉德极限下严格推导的玻尔兹曼方程，考察H函数与熵的演化差异及其根源。
AI.result: 发现H函数在严格导出的玻尔兹曼方程中无法作为有效的时间箭头判据。
AI.conclusion: H函数不能充当严格玻尔兹曼方程中的时间箭头判据，其与熵的演化不一致。

title: A concentration-independent paradigm rendering weak interactions inherently quantifiable
comment: 95 pages, 6 figures, 19 supplementary figures. Companion paper submitted simultaneously: "Experimental access to molarity's blind spot in macroscopic assays" (F. Matsuda, M. Yoshimura, S. Ikeda, D. Fujita). Cross-references to the companion arXiv identifier will be added in v2
summary: A vast class of weak, millimolar-affinity molecular interactions governs cellular function, yet their quantitative characterization has remained largely beyond conventional methods. For over a century, biochemistry has worked within a concentration-based framework where molarity scales with molecular number per volume (N/V), and experiments have usually, often implicitly, changed concentration by moving N while holding V fixed. The weak-interaction measurement bottleneck arises from this paradigm: reading weak binding through bulk concentration requires concentrations beyond practical limits, a framework constraint rather than one of instrumental sensitivity. Here we show that shifting experimental control from N to accessible volume V overcomes this bottleneck and opens previously intractable affinity ranges through nanoscale spatial confinement. Controlling V means controlling what biochemists have called "local concentration" and "proximity effects," recasting these long-ambiguous notions as quantitative variables grounded in first principles. Implemented in DNA nanocavities, the approach showed that geometric arrangement alone can override solution-phase binding hierarchies. The same spatial control quantified a protein-peptide interaction of order 10 mM from femtomoles per well, totalling under a picomole per titration. Even so, a standard plate reader gave a signal-to-noise ratio near 10^3, leaving headroom for still weaker interactions. The affinity-and-geometry readout also enabled rational screening for protein-protein-interaction modulators, identifying compounds that enhance weak associations by reweighting local encounters rather than binding tightly on their own or forming a stable ternary complex. Together, this volume-based paradigm and its implementation provide a general strategy for probing and modulating previously inaccessible biochemical phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以体积（V）而非浓度（N/V）为实验控制变量的新范式，通过纳米级空间限域来测量和调控毫摩尔级弱分子相互作用，突破了传统生物化学浓度框架下无法定量弱结合的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 大量细胞功能由毫摩尔级弱亲和力的分子相互作用调控，但传统生物化学一直以浓度（N/V）为框架，常通过改变N而非V来控制浓度。要读取弱结合需要远超实际可行的浓度，这是框架性限制而非仪器灵敏度问题。作者旨在通过控制体积V来克服这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 将实验控制从分子数N转向可及体积V，通过纳米级空间限域控制局部浓度/邻近效应，将这些概念转化为基于第一性原理的定量变量。在DNA纳米腔中实现该策略，用于测量弱亲和力相互作用，并利用亲和力-几何学双重读出进行PPI调节剂筛选。
AI.result: 几何排列本身即可推翻溶液相中的结合层级；在标准板读数器上，仅用飞摩尔级样品量（总量低于皮摩尔）即可定量约10 mM的蛋白-肽相互作用，信噪比接近10^3。该平台还成功筛选出通过重加权局部遭遇（而非自身强结合或形成稳定三元复合物）来增强弱相互作用的PPI调节剂。
AI.conclusion: 基于体积控制的范式为探测和调控此前无法触及的生化现象提供了通用策略，有望打开弱相互作用测量的新领域。

title: Scale-covariant liquid in nonlocal high Tc strange metals
summary: Experiments in recent years on high $T_c$ superconductors find a puzzling nodal scale-covariant self-energy with an exponent varying continuously with doping. We propose a mechanism: nonlocality induced by poorly screened effective repulsions $V_α(r) \sim 1/r^α$, where a continuously doping-dependent exponent $1 \le α\le 3$ naturally interpolates between the Mott insulating and Fermi liquid limits. We develop a phenomenology of hydrodynamic screening, finding a scale-covariant quasiparticle decay rate $Γ(ω,T) \propto T^γ Φ(ω/T)$ in energy $ω$ and temperature $T$, with $γ= 2-\frac{1}α$ for nonlocal $ 1 < α< 2$. Our results naturally capture the optimally doped to overdoped regimes, whereas the underdoped regime is qualitatively distinct. In our theory, spectroscopy-fitted exponents directly probe the charged fluid's effective spatial nonlocality. Nonlocality shows that quantum criticality is not necessary to explain scale-covariant phenomena.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种解释高温超导体中节点尺度协变自能的新机制：由屏蔽不良的有效排斥作用V_α(r) ~ 1/r^α引起的非局域性。通过流体动力学屏蔽现象学，发现准粒子衰减率Γ(ω,T) ∝ T^γ Φ(ω/T)遵循尺度协变规律，指数γ = 2-1/α连续依赖于掺杂，自然解释了从最佳掺杂到过掺杂的实验观测。
AI.motivation: 近年实验发现高温超导体中节点自能呈现令人困惑的尺度协变行为，其指数随掺杂连续变化。研究者希望找到一个统一机制来解释这一现象，而非依赖量子临界性等传统解释框架。
AI.method: 提出非局域性机制：屏蔽不良的有效排斥相互作用V_α(r) ~ 1/r^α具有连续掺杂依赖的指数1 ≤ α ≤ 3，可在Mott绝缘体和费米液体极限之间自然插值。发展流体动力学屏蔽现象学，推导出尺度协变的准粒子衰减率。
AI.result: 推导出尺度协变衰减率Γ(ω,T) ∝ T^γ Φ(ω/T)，其中γ = 2 - 1/α对应于非局域1 < α < 2区域。该结果自然捕捉最佳掺杂到过掺杂区间的行为，而过掺杂区间定性不同。光谱拟合的指数直接反映带电流体的有效空间非局域性。
AI.conclusion: 非局域性机制表明量子临界性并非解释尺度协变现象的必要条件。该理论为理解高温超导体中掺杂依赖的尺度协变自能提供了新的视角，并建立了观测指数与系统有效非局域性之间的直接联系。

title: Apparent Dresselhaus coefficient in (001) GaAs quantum wells: Correlation-time renormalization in D'yakonov-Perel' spin relaxation
summary: We study the Dresselhaus coefficient inferred from D'yakonov-Perel' spin relaxation in bulk GaAs and (001) GaAs quantum wells using nonballistic Monte Carlo simulations. In bulk GaAs, inelastic LO-phonon simulations reproduce the spin relaxation with a cubic Dresselhaus coefficient γ_{3D}\simeq12.4 eVÅ^3 and a cubic-field correlation time τ_3^{3D}\simeq150 fs. In a projected two-dimensional quantum-well model, however, k_z^2 is replaced by the static expectation value \langle k_z^2 \rangle, converting the dominant Dresselhaus field into a term linear in the in-plane wave vector. We show that this projection changes the D'yakonov-Perel' correlation kernel from K_3^{2D} to a first- and third-order hybridized kernel K_{1+3}^{2D}, for which the correlation time τ_{1+3}^{2D} approaches 235 fs in the strict two-dimensional limit, in contrast to the third-order correlation time τ_3^{2D} of 130 fs. Consequently, the coefficient entering the projected two-dimensional model is not the intrinsic cubic coefficient itself but an apparent coefficient, γ_{2D}^{app}=γ_{3D} \sqrt{τ_3^{2D}/τ_{1+3}^{2D}}. Since τ_{1+3}^{2D}\simeq1.8τ_3^{2D} under LO-phonon-dominated scattering, γ_{2D}^{app}\simeq9.2 eVÅ^3, consistent with spin relaxation in (001) GaAs quantum wells. This correlation-time renormalization clarifies why Dresselhaus coefficients extracted from two-dimensional spin relaxation can differ from the cubic bulk coefficient and provides a useful framework for interpreting linear and cubic Dresselhaus parameters in quantum wells.

AI.tldr: 本文通过非弹道蒙特卡洛模拟研究体GaAs和(001) GaAs量子阱中由D'yakonov-Perel'自旋弛豫推得的Dresselhaus系数。研究发现，从三维体材料投影到二维量子阱模型时，相关时间会被重整化（从130 fs增加到235 fs），导致从二维模型提取的Dresselhaus系数是表观系数γ_{2D}^{app}≈9.2 eVÅ³，而非本征的体立方系数12.4 eVÅ³。这一相关时间重整化机制解释了为何二维自旋弛豫提取的Dresselhaus系数与体立方系数不同。
AI.motivation: 理解Dresselhaus系数在体材料与量子阱之间的差异来源。实验中从二维量子阱自旋弛豫提取的Dresselhaus系数常与体材料立方系数不一致，需要澄清这一差异的物理机制，为正确解释线性与立方Dresselhaus参数提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用非弹道蒙特卡洛模拟方法，分别模拟体GaAs和(001) GaAs量子阱中的D'yakonov-Perel'自旋弛豫过程。在体材料中考虑非弹性LO声子散射；在二维投影模型中引入静态期望值<k_z²>将立方Dresselhaus场转化为线性项，并分析由此产生的混合相关核K_{1+3}^{2D}以及相应的相关时间重整化。
AI.result: 体GaAs中，非弹性LO声子模拟得到立方Dresselhaus系数γ_{3D}≈12.4 eVÅ³和立方场相关时间τ_3^{3D}≈150 fs。二维模型中，投影将相关核从三阶K_3^{2D}转变为混合核K_{1+3}^{2D}，相关时间从130 fs增至235 fs。由于τ_{1+3}^{2D}≈1.8τ_3^{2D}，表观系数γ_{2D}^{app}≈9.2 eVÅ³，与(001) GaAs量子阱的实验结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 二维量子阱中提取的Dresselhaus系数与本征体立方系数不同，根源在于维度投影引起的相关时间重整化。该发现为理解量子阱中线性与立方Dresselhaus参数提供了统一框架，澄清了文献中长期存在的系数分歧。

title: Hidden Quantum Geometry in Bilayer Exciton Condensates
comment: Maintext: 6 pages, 2 figures; Supplemental material: 5 pages
summary: When an electron-doped layer is stacked with a hole-doped layer with approximately equal carrier density, inter-layer Coulomb interaction turns the bilayer system into an exciton condensate (EC). In this Letter, we reveal a fundamental property of bilayer ECs: the excitonic order gives rise to nontrivial hidden quantum geometric effects in the correlated electron-hole bands, even when the non-interacting bands are trivial. Such peculiar EC-driven quantum geometry manifests itself in a characteristic out-of-plane polarization response upon applying an in-plane AC electric field to the bilayer EC system. In particular, the second-order response exhibits a characteristic inverse square scaling with the bilayer EC order parameter. Our finding reveals a fundamental hidden Berry phase effect driven by electron-hole correlations, and establishes bilayer EC as a promising platform for rich nonlinear physics.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了双层激子凝聚体中的一个基本性质：即使非相互作用能带是平凡的，激子序也会在关联的电子-空穴能带中产生非平凡的隐藏量子几何效应。这种量子几何效应表现为施加面内交流电场时特征性的面外极化响应，其二阶响应与双层激子凝聚序参量呈特征性的平方反比标度关系。
AI.motivation: 探索双层激子凝聚体中激子序对量子几何（贝里相位）效应的影响，揭示电子-空穴关联驱动的隐藏量子几何效应，建立双层激子凝聚体作为丰富非线性物理平台的可能性。
AI.method: 理论分析双层电子-空穴掺杂堆叠形成的激子凝聚系统，研究激子序参量如何在关联能带中引入量子几何效应，并分析施加面内交流电场时的非线性极化响应。
AI.result: 发现激子序在原本拓扑平凡的能带中诱导出非平凡的隐藏量子几何效应；该效应表现为施加面内交流电场时的面外极化响应，其二阶响应部分与激子凝聚序参量成平方反比关系。
AI.conclusion: 该发现揭示了由电子-空穴关联驱动的隐藏贝里相位效应的基本机制，为双层激子凝聚体作为非线性光学和量子几何研究的前沿平台提供了理论基础。

title: The intermediate scattering function of an interacting adlayer as a characteristic function: a closed-form theory of Ising lattice-gas surface diffusion
summary: The intermediate scattering function (ISF) measured by helium spin-echo is a characteristic function (CF): the Fourier transform of the distribution of adsorbate displacements, whose value at zero time is the static structure factor. We use this double role to bring lateral interactions of Ising lattice-gas type into surface diffusion. The ISF then follows in closed form in momentum transfer, time, coverage and temperature, and with it the whole linear-response hierarchy. A single correlation parameter fixes both the equilibrium structure and the interaction-renormalized hop rate; it is exact along a one-dimensional channel, and is carried onto the surface as the nearest-neighbour correlation of a pair approximation, the momentum dependence of the structure factor then coming from a collective (random-phase) treatment. The closed form is not postulated. Projecting the master equation onto the density gives an exact equation of motion whose amplitude is an identity and whose initial rate obeys a sum rule, so that the quasi-elastic weight is the layer's own structure factor and de Gennes narrowing becomes a theorem rather than an analogy; the closed form is what remains when the memory kernel of that equation is dropped. Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) on the same Hamiltonian reproduces the dressed hop rate to better than about one per cent and the initial collective rate to $1$--$2\%$. Four correlated, non-critical fingerprints of the interaction follow --- in the quasi-elastic amplitude, its linewidth, the Arrhenius slope, and the dependence of the fitted linewidth on the range of times over which the decay is fitted. They invert in closed form for the attempt frequency, the static barrier and the interaction. Applications to Na/Cu(111) and H/Pt(111) are analysed and discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了如何将Ising格子气体类型的横向相互作用引入表面扩散的氦自旋回波测量中。中间散射函数（ISF）作为特征函数以闭式形式得到，涵盖动量转移、时间、覆盖率和温度，并推导出完整的线性响应层级。一个单一的关联参数同时决定平衡结构和相互作用重正化的跳跃速率。该闭式形式通过投影主方程得到，且与动力学蒙特卡洛模拟吻合良好（跳跃速率误差<1%，初始集体速率误差1-2%）。论文识别出四个关联的、非临界的相互作用指纹，并可在闭式中反演得到尝试频率、静态势垒和相互作用。
AI.motivation: 表面扩散中吸附质之间的横向相互作用对中间散射函数（ISF）有重要影响，但此前缺乏一个既准确又解析可解的理论框架来描述这种相互作用如何进入实验可观测的ISF中。ISF作为特征函数的双重角色（零时刻值为静态结构因子）尚未被充分利用来将相互作用系统地引入表面扩散理论。
AI.method: 本文利用ISF作为特征函数的性质，将其零时间值（静态结构因子）与吸附质位移分布联系起来，从而引入Ising格子气体的横向相互作用。通过将主方程投影到密度上获得精确的运动方程，利用振幅恒等式和初始速率求和规则，使得准弹性权重恰好等于层自身的结构因子（de Gennes窄化成为定理而非类比）。闭式形式在丢弃该方程的记忆核后得出。一维通道上精确求解，表面上通过最近邻关联的对近似和集体随机相位处理实现。
AI.result: 获得了ISF的闭式解析表达式，涵盖动量、时间、覆盖率和温度四个维度。动力学蒙特卡洛验证表明重正化跳跃速率误差小于1%，初始集体速率误差为1-2%。识别出四个关联的、非临界的相互作用指纹：准弹性振幅、线宽、Arrhenius斜率以及拟合线宽对衰减拟合时间范围的依赖。这些指纹可在闭式中反演，得到尝试频率、静态势垒和相互作用强度。成功应用于Na/Cu(111)和H/Pt(111)体系。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个将横向相互作用纳入表面扩散氦自旋回波测量的严格且解析可用的理论框架。该方法不仅从第一性原理角度（投影主方程）推导出闭式形式，避免了经验性假设，而且通过四个可观测的指纹实现相互作用参数的闭式反演，为表面扩散实验提供了定量分析工具。

title: Adaptive Inference and Convergence of Free Energy Landscapes Using Non-parametric Bayesian Enhanced Sampling
summary: Enhanced sampling techniques are central to the study of statistically rare events in the computer modeling and simulation of molecular phenomena. In this work, we report the development and integration of a Gaussian process model, adaptive, uncertainty-driven sampling scheme for enhanced sampling. The framework trains a Gaussian process model on an iteratively improving estimate of the free energy landscape. Regions of high uncertainty within the reaction phase space are increasingly sampled, and the uncertainty is computed on-the-fly during free energy reconstruction, serving as a convergence metric. This approach provides a generalizable strategy that can be extended to complex molecular processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于高斯过程模型的自适应、不确定性驱动的增强采样方案，用于分子模拟中稀有事件的统计研究。该方法通过迭代估计自由能景观，并在反应相空间中重点采样高不确定性区域，同时将实时计算的不确定性作为收敛指标。
AI.motivation: 增强采样技术是研究分子现象中统计稀有事件的核心手段，但现有方法在自由能景观重建的效率和准确性方面存在局限，需要一种更通用、可扩展的策略来应对复杂分子过程。
AI.method: 将高斯过程模型与自适应采样框架相结合：在自由能景观的迭代估计上训练高斯过程模型，通过采样反应相空间中高不确定性的区域来引导采样过程，并在自由能重建过程中实时计算不确定性作为收敛性度量。
AI.result: 该方法提供了一种通用化的增强采样策略，具备不确定性驱动的自适应采样能力和实时收敛性评估功能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有较好的通用性和可扩展性，可推广应用于复杂分子过程的增强采样研究。

title: Quaternion-Kahler geometry of time reversal symmetric crystals
summary: Quantum geometry reveals how the shape of Bloch wave functions governs correlated quantum phenomena. Its standard formulation describes isolated complex bands, where Berry curvature is Abelian and ideal geometry is Kahler. However, time reversal symmetric crystals with spin require a different language since Kramers degeneracy pairs Bloch states and turns Berry curvature into a non-Abelian SU(2) field. Here we show that Kramers pair band geometry is quaternionic. A minimal Kramers pair defines a map into quaternion projective space, and its quaternionic quantum geometric tensor unifies the quantum metric with the three SU(2) Berry curvature components. The non-negativity of this tensor imposes local metric-curvature inequalities, whose saturation defines the non-Abelian counterpart of ideal Chern bands. In four dimensions, the ideal limit further yields an algebraic structure related to the four-dimensional quantum Hall effect. Our results promote ideal quantum geometry from the Abelian geometry of Chern bands to the quaternionic, non-Abelian geometry of time reversal symmetric quantum matter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间反演对称晶体中Kramers配对带的量子几何是四元数（quaternionic）的，而非传统阿贝尔（Abelian）的。通过四元数量子几何张量，统一了量子度规与SU(2) Berry曲率的三个分量，并导出了非阿贝尔理想带的判据，即局部度规-曲率不等式饱和条件。
AI.motivation: 标准量子几何框架描述的是孤立复能带，其中Berry曲率为阿贝尔型、理想几何为Kähler型。但时间反演对称且含自旋的晶体中，Kramers简并把Bloch态成对配对，使Berry曲率变成非阿贝尔的SU(2)场，因此需要新的几何语言来描述这类体系。
AI.method: 作者证明Kramers配对带几何本质上是四元数的：最小Kramers对定义了到四元数射影空间的映射，并提出了四元数量子几何张量，该张量统一了量子度规和三个SU(2) Berry曲率分量。张量的非负性给出局部度规-曲率不等式，其饱和定义了非阿贝尔理想带（类比Chern带的理想几何）。在四维情形下，理想极限还导出与四维量子霍尔效应相关的代数结构。
AI.result: 建立了非阿贝尔量子几何的完整框架：四元数量子几何张量、度规-曲率不等式及其饱和条件，并在四维空间中联系到四维量子霍尔效应的代数结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将理想量子几何从Chern带的阿贝尔几何推广到时间反演对称量子物质的四元数、非阿贝尔几何，为理解这类体系中的相关量子现象提供了新的几何工具。

title: Fibonacci number systems and the localization criterion in the many-body Aubry-André model
summary: We introduce an extension of the Fibonacci number system, we call the fractional Fibonacci number system, which interpolates between the Fibonacci number system (used for natural numbers) and the irrational base-$φ$ number system, which can be used to represent real numbers. The number system finds its use in interpreting the localization phase diagram of the many-body non-interacting Aubry-André model. For finite system sizes a localization criterion can be obtained if the particle density is written in the fractional Fibonacci number system. In the thermodynamic limit, the criterion remains, but in this case the particle density is expressed in base-$φ$. The nature of the thermodynamic limit is also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"分数斐波那契数制"（fractional Fibonacci number system），它介于自然数的斐波那契数制与实数的无理数基底φ数制之间，并用于解释多体无相互作用Aubry-André模型的局域化相图。
AI.motivation: 斐波那契数制适用于自然数，而基底-φ数制适用于实数，两者之间存在鸿沟。作者希望找到一个统一的数制框架，能够恰好用于解读Aubry-André模型中粒子密度与局域化判据之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出了分数斐波那契数制这一新的数制扩展，将粒子密度用该数制表示，在有限体系尺寸下获得局域化判据；在热力学极限下，粒子密度改用基底-φ数制表达，判据依然成立。
AI.result: 在有限体系下，通过分数斐波那契数制表示粒子密度可获得局域化判据；在热力学极限下，局域化判据保持成立，但需以基底-φ数制来表达粒子密度。
AI.conclusion: 分数斐波那契数制成功连接了两种已有数制，并为Aubry-André模型的局域化现象提供了一种新的数学解释框架；同时论文还讨论了热力学极限的性质。

title: Resolving Peak Shifting Effects in Real-Time Time-Dependent Orbital Propagation Methods Through Nonorthogonal Expansions
summary: Self-consistent field real-time electronic structure methods are a powerful approach for modeling ultrafast processes but suffer from systematic errors in predicted transition energies, commonly known as peak shifting, that obscure direct comparison with experiment. Although this effect has been explored in single reference methods, a general understanding that extends to multiconfigurational methods remains unresolved. Here, we develop a real-time nonorthogonal multiconfigurational self-consistent field (RT-TD NOMCSCF) formalism in which independently propagated orbital sets generate a compact, nonorthogonal wavefunction. The approach establishes a unified framework for nonlinear real-time electronic structure theories, which we use to reveal the common origin of peak shifting across single and multireference limits. Using this framework, we demonstrate that peak shifting does not arise exclusively from the effect of state averaging over the internal space basis, but also from the accessible external configurational space. By systematically expanding the internal space with independently propagated orbital sets, RT-TD NOMCSCF suppresses this aver- aging, recovers correct transition energies, and distinguishes intrinsic peak shifting from numerical peak drifting caused by propagation errors. Thus, these developments establish nonlinear real-time electronic structure methods that enables more accurate simulations of ultrafast processes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了实时非正交多组态自洽场（RT-TD NOMCSCF）方法，通过独立传播的轨道集构建紧凑的非正交波函数，统一了非线性实时电子结构理论，并揭示了单参考与多参考极限下峰移现象的共同起源。
AI.motivation: 传统的实时自洽场电子结构方法在预测跃迁能量时存在系统误差（峰移现象），影响与实验的直接比较。虽然该效应已在单参考方法中被研究，但在多组态方法中的一般性理解仍不明确，需要建立统一框架来阐明其机制。
AI.method: 开发RT-TD NOMCSCF形式体系，采用独立传播的轨道集生成紧凑的非正交波函数。通过系统扩展内空间（内部空间）的独立传播轨道集，抑制状态平均效应，并区分固有的峰移与由传播误差导致的数值漂移。
AI.result: 该框架证明峰移不仅源于内部空间基的状态平均效应，还源于可访问的外部组态空间。RT-TD NOMCSCF能够恢复正确的跃迁能量，并将固有峰移与数值峰漂移区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了非线性实时电子结构方法，为超快过程提供了更准确的模拟能力，深化了对单参考与多参考统一框架下峰移机制的理解。

title: Contrasting anisotropic electron-phonon-spin coupling in Fe$_{3}$GeTe$_{2}$ and Fe$_{5}$GeTe$_{2}$: A helicity-resolved Raman study
comment: Main text: 15 pages, 8 figures + Supplemental Material: 6 pages, 5 figures
summary: Two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnets Fe$_3$GeTe$ _2$ (F3GT) and Fe$_5$GeTe$_2$ (F5GT) exhibit pronounced magneto-optical responses, which open promising platforms for investigating the interplay among lattice, electronic, and magnetic degrees of freedom. Here, we present a comparative study of optical resonance-induced anisotropic electron-phonon coupling and its association with magnetic ordering in these systems using wavelength- and temperature-dependent helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy. By resolving the doubly degenerate E modes under left- and right-circularly polarized excitations, we demonstrate that the temperature evolution of the chiral mode splitting ($Δf$) does not track the magnetization behavior, indicating that the helicity-dependent Raman response arises not solely from time-reversal symmetry breaking due to magnetic order, but also from spin-orbit-coupled electronic interactions. Notably, in F3GT, the out-of-plane magnetization indirectly governs the in-plane anisotropic electron-phonon coupling under optical resonance, whereas F5GT exhibits static anisotropic interactions. The Fano asymmetry parameter $1/q$ reveals mode- and temperature-dependent coupling strengths between phonons and the electronic continuum, with pronounced angular anisotropy in F3GT but isotropic behavior in F5GT--- a consequence of its multiple Fe sites and enhanced interlayer hybridization in the latter. Our results demonstrate the role of crystal structure and magnetic anisotropy in shaping the anisotropically coupled electron-phonon-spin dynamics in these layered metallic ferromagnets, and highlight Fe$_x$GeTe$_2$ as a versatile platform for microscopic insight into chiral light-matter interactions in layered metallic ferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过波长和温度依赖的手性分辨拉曼光谱，比较研究了二维范德华铁磁体Fe₃GeTe₂（F3GT）和Fe₅GeTe₂（F5GT）中光学共振诱导的各向异性电子-声子耦合及其与磁有序的关联，揭示了手性模式劈裂的温度演化不追踪磁化行为，并展示了晶体结构和磁各向异性在塑造各向异性电子-声子-自旋动力学中的作用。
AI.motivation: 二维范德华铁磁体F3GT和F5GT具有显著的磁光响应，为研究晶格、电子和磁自由度之间的相互作用提供了平台。理解其光学共振下各向异性电子-声子耦合与磁有序的关联，对于深入认识层状金属铁磁体中的手性光-物质相互作用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用波长和温度依赖的手性分辨拉曼光谱（helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy），在左旋和右旋圆偏振激发下解析双重简并E模，通过手性模式劈裂（Δf）的温度演化、Fano不对称参数1/q以及角度依赖的各向异性分析，对比研究F3GT和F5GT的电子-声子-自旋耦合特性。

title: Bias Tunable Transport Modulation and Gas Selectivity in Layered BiOI: A DFT NEGF Study
summary: Understanding the interplay between adsorption energetics and charge-transport modulation is essential for the rational design of low-power and bias-tunable gas sensors. Here, we present a comprehensive first-principles study of gas selectivity in layered bismuth oxyiodide (BiOI) by integrating density functional theory with nonequilibrium Green's function transport calculations. The adsorption and bias-dependent transport responses toward NO2, NH3, CO2, and representative volatile organic compounds are systematically examined. While NH3 and NO2 exhibit strong chemisorption and localized electronic perturbations, CO2 interacts through weak physisorption, demonstrating that adsorption strength alone does not determine sensing performance. Instead, the evolution of transmission channels near the Fermi level governs the sensing response. Bias-dependent calculations reveal an electrically tunable sensitivity hierarchy, in which weakly adsorbed CO2 preserves conductive pathways and exhibits pronounced low-bias sensitivity despite minimal charge transfer. Recovery-time analysis further highlights the trade-off between transport modulation and reversibility for strongly adsorbed species. These results establish a transport-centered selectivity framework for layered BiOI and provide mechanistic insight into electric-field-controlled gas sensing under ambient conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过密度泛函理论与非平衡格林函数输运计算相结合，系统研究了层状BiOI材料对不同气体（NO2、NH3、CO2及VOCs）的选择性传感机制，揭示了传输通道演化而非吸附强度是决定传感性能的关键因素，并展示了电场可调的气敏响应特性。
AI.motivation: 设计低功耗、偏压可调的电阻式气体传感器需要深入理解吸附能量学与电荷传输调控之间的相互作用关系，而传统气敏研究往往过于关注吸附能大小，忽略了传输通道演化对传感性能的决定性作用。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算框架，将密度泛函理论（DFT）与非平衡格林函数（NEGF）输运计算相结合，系统研究BiOI对NO2、NH3、CO2及代表性挥发性有机化合物的吸附和偏压依赖性输运响应。
AI.result: NH3和NO2表现出强化学吸附和局域电子扰动，而CO2仅通过弱物理吸附作用；弱吸附的CO2在低偏压下反而表现出显著的灵敏度，说明吸附强度不能单独决定传感性能，费米能级附近透射通道的演化才是传感响应的主导因素。恢复时间分析揭示了强吸附物种在传输调控与可逆性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 建立了以传输为中心的层状BiOI气敏选择性框架，为环境条件下电场控制气体传感提供了机理层面的认识，有助于理性设计低功耗、栅压可调的气体传感器。

title: Helicity in monoaxial chiral magnets
summary: The equilibrium state of a monoaxial chiral magnet surrounded by a non-magnetic medium (such as air or vacuum) is a helical texture characterized by a single, well-defined wave vector. No metastable states have ever been observed in such systems. Recently, however, it was demonstrated that when a chiral magnet is in close contact with two uniaxial ferromagnets, a large number of metastable helical states emerge in addition to the equilibrium state [Phys. Rev. B 109, 214424]. These helical states are distinguished by their wave number (helicity). In the present work, we elucidate the topological origin of the stabilization of these states --a mechanism we term dynamical topological protection-- and investigate their static and dynamic properties. We find that, as a consequence of this dynamical topological protection, the winding number of the helical states remains constant under the application of sufficiently weak magnetic fields and polarized electric currents. Furthermore, when a polarized current is applied to a metastable helical state, a static configuration is reached. This state retains the original winding number, but its winding number density becomes non-homogeneously distributed, concentrating near the interface with one of the ferromagnets. The dynamic response to sufficiently large magnetic fields and currents provides mechanisms to switch between different helical states. Since the magnetic properties depend on helicity, these metastable helical states are highly promising for applications in spintronics and magnonics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单轴手性磁体与两个单轴铁磁体接触时出现的亚稳态螺旋态，阐明其稳定化的拓扑起源（称为"动力学拓扑保护"），并研究其静态和动态性质。研究表明在弱磁场和极化电流下，螺旋态的缠绕数保持不变；施加极化电流可达到保持原始缠绕数但密度非均匀分布的静态构型；足够强的磁场和电流可提供不同螺旋态之间的切换机制，在自旋电子学和磁子学中有应用前景。
AI.motivation: 在单轴手性磁体被非磁性介质包围的平衡态中，仅存在单一波矢的螺旋纹理，从未观察到亚稳态。然而近期发现当手性磁体与两个单轴铁磁体紧密接触时，会出现大量亚稳态螺旋态，这些态按波数（螺旋度）区分。本研究旨在阐明这些亚稳态稳定化的拓扑起源（动力学拓扑保护机制），并探索其静态和动态性质，以理解其潜在应用价值。
AI.method: 通过理论分析阐明亚稳态螺旋态稳定化的动力学拓扑保护机制；研究弱磁场和极化电流下螺旋态缠绕数的守恒性；分析极化电流作用下亚稳态螺旋态达到静态构型时的缠绕数密度分布；探讨足够强磁场和电流诱导不同螺旋态之间切换的动态响应机制。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 动力学拓扑保护使螺旋态在弱磁场和极化电流下缠绕数保持恒定；(2) 施加极化电流后，亚稳态螺旋态达到静态构型，保留原始缠绕数但缠绕数密度非均匀分布，集中靠近某一铁磁体界面；(3) 足够强的磁场和电流可实现不同螺旋态之间的切换。
AI.conclusion: 这些亚稳态螺旋态由于磁性性质依赖于螺旋度，在自旋电子学和磁子学领域具有高度前景的应用潜力，为新型磁存储和信息处理器件提供了可能。

title: Lower bounds on entropy production from dynamical correlation functions
summary: Entropy production is a key property in stochastic thermodynamics. For partially observed and coarse-grained systems, its inference is challenging and typically rests on proven lower bounds. We derive two versions of such bounds based on the asymmetry of experimentally accessible two-time correlation functions of coarse-grained state observables. For non-equilibrium steady states, the bound is valid for arbitrary correlation lag. For time-dependent processes, it requires the limit of vanishing lag. These bounds hold true for any system that follows either a Markovian dynamics or a coupled set of overdamped Langevin equations on some underlying, unobservable level of description. We illustrate the bounds for both types of dynamics and discuss their optimization and potential tightness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对部分观测和粗粒化系统的随机热力学中熵产生推断问题，推导出基于实验可观测的两时间相关函数不对称性的两个熵产生下界。一个适用于任意相关滞后的非平衡稳态，另一个适用于趋零滞后极限的时间依赖过程。两个下界对任何遵循马尔可夫动力学或过阻尼朗之万方程的系统均成立。
AI.motivation: 在随机热力学中，熵产生是关键性质，但对于部分观测和粗粒化系统，其推断具有挑战性，通常依赖于已证明的下界。本文旨在利用实验可获取的粗粒化状态可观测量的两时间相关函数不对称性，推导新的熵产生下界，为不可观测的微观层面的熵产生估计提供更实用的工具。
AI.method: 作者基于两时间相关函数的时间不对称性推导了两类熵产生下界：(1) 针对非平衡稳态，下界对任意相关滞后均成立；(2) 针对时间依赖过程，下界需要滞后趋近于零的极限条件。这些下界适用于任何在不可观测的底层层面上遵循马尔可夫动力学或耦合过阻尼朗之万方程的系统。作者通过在两类动力学上的示例说明了这些下界，并讨论了其优化和潜在紧致性。
AI.result: 作者成功推导出两种基于两时间相关函数不对称性的熵产生下界，分别适用于非平衡稳态（任意滞后）和时间依赖过程（零滞后极限），并通过数值示例验证了其有效性，同时探讨了这些下界的优化途径和紧密性。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了基于实验可观测相关函数不对称性的熵产生下界，为部分观测系统的非平衡热力学推断提供了新的理论工具，并在马尔可夫动力学和过阻尼朗之万系统两大类动力学框架下均成立。

title: Cooling down trees for finite-temperature quantum dynamics: Purification within ML-MCTDH
summary: Simulating multidimensional quantum systems at finite temperature is inherently challenging as the system is no longer described by a single, pure-state wavefunction but by a density operator, squaring an already exponential scaling of the Hilbert space. Building upon the compact wavefunction ansatz of the multi-layer multiconfiguration time-dependent Hartree (ML-MCTDH) method, we present a new scheme for simulating finite-temperature quantum dynamics based on purification. Here, a density operator is mapped to a single ML-MCTDH wavefunction in an enlarged Hilbert space, comprising physical and auxiliary degrees of freedom. In the key step, one obtains a pure-state representation of the canonical density operator via imaginary time-propagation of the infinite-temperature state. The most important observation is that this state can be exactly decomposed as a Hartree product of maximally entangled combined modes, each combined mode consisting of a physical degree of freedom and its auxiliary counterpart. Through dynamically pruning the node ranks of the ML-tree during the "cool down" stage yields a compact finite-temperature wavefunction, thus accelerating the real-time propagation and enabling finite-temperature simulations of multidimensional, correlated molecular systems. Our method circumvents both intensive statistical sampling and costly tensor-decomposition of the full density-operator, while being broadly applicable to model Hamiltonians and general ab initio potential energy surfaces alike. Two applications of the method are presented, benchmark results on the thermal ground-state of H2O as well as temperature-dependent infrared absorption spectra of the more challenging, floppy H3O2- anion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ML-MCTDH方法的新方案，通过纯化（purification）技术将有限温度量子动力学中的密度算符映射为扩展希尔伯特空间中的单一纯态波函数，从而避免了统计采样和全密度算符的张量分解，实现了多维关联分子体系的有限温度量子动力学模拟。
AI.motivation: 模拟多维量子系统在有限温度下的动力学本质上具有挑战性，因为系统不再由单一的纯态波函数描述，而是由密度算符描述，这使得希尔伯特空间的指数级缩放问题变得更加严重。现有方法要么需要密集的统计采样，要么需要对完整密度算符进行昂贵的张量分解。
AI.method: 基于多层多组态含时Hartree（ML-MCTDH）方法的紧凑波函数拟设，利用纯化技术将密度算符映射到包含物理和辅助自由度的扩展希尔伯特空间中的单一ML-MCTDH波函数。关键步骤是通过虚时间传播无穷温度态来获得正则密度算符的纯态表示，该态可以精确分解为最大纠缠组合模式的Hartree积。在"冷却"阶段动态剪枝ML树的节点秩，获得紧凑的有限温度波函数，从而加速实时传播。
AI.result: 该方法在H2O分子的热基态基准测试以及更具挑战性的柔性H3O2-阴离子的温度依赖红外吸收光谱两个应用中展示了良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法规避了密集统计采样和全密度算符的昂贵张量分解，广泛适用于模型哈密顿量和通用从头算势能面，为多维关联分子体系的有限温度模拟提供了有效途径。

title: Fluctuations of topological charges in two-dimensional classical Heisenberg model through high-temperature and low-temperature expansions
summary: It is well known that KT transition in 2d XY model is driven by the binding and unbinding of topological defects, which can be characterized by the fluctuation of topological charges inside a region. We extend the idea into the 2d Heisenberg model and calculate the fluctuation through high-temperature and low-temperature expansion respectively. It is found that the fluctuation of topological charges is proportional to the area of the region at high temperatures while obeys the perimeter law at low temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维Heisenberg模型中拓扑电荷的涨落行为，发现高温下涨落正比于区域面积，低温下服从周长律，这一转变可能与KT相变类似地由拓扑缺陷的束缚与解束缚驱动。
AI.motivation: 二维XY模型中的KT相变由拓扑缺陷的束缚与解束缚驱动，可通过区域内拓扑电荷的涨落来表征。作者希望将该思想推广到二维Heisenberg模型，以探究其拓扑性质。
AI.method: 将KT转变中拓扑电荷涨落表征的思想推广到二维Heisenberg模型，分别通过高温展开和低温展开来计算区域内拓扑电荷的涨落。
AI.result: 高温下，拓扑电荷涨落与区域面积成正比（面积律）；低温下，涨落服从周长律。
AI.conclusion: 二维Heisenberg模型中拓扑电荷涨落在高温和低温下呈现截然不同的标度行为（面积律vs周长律），暗示可能存在类似KT转变的拓扑相变。

title: Picometre-scale real-time drift correction in TEM and STEM by dynamic control of the specimen stage for atomic-resolution imaging
comment: 27 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to Ultramicroscopy Christophe Gatel: Writing original draft, Software, Methodology, Investigation, Data treatment, Conceptualization, Resources, Funding acquisition. Julien Dupuis: Software, Conceptualization, Methodology. Teresa Hungria: STEM experiment, Review & editing. Martin Hytch: Review & editing, Data treatment, Resources, Funding acquisition
summary: In this work, we show how the specimen drift can be actively compensated by controlling the stage with precision down to the picometre scale. We do this by dynamic control, a generic real-time feedback framework designed to actively stabilize electron microscopy experiments by continuously monitoring an experimental variable from the detector data stream and compensating its evolution during acquisition. The framework, applicable to a broad range of controllable experimental instabilities, includes automated calibration procedures, operates in parallel with image acquisition and is implemented as a software plugin without requiring any hardware modification of the microscope. Results for live drift correction are shown for a selection of TEM and STEM instruments using conventional mechanical stages as well as piezoelectric stages. Experimental results are presented for medium resolution TEM, high-resolution TEM, HR-STEM and in situ observations. With piezoelectric stages, specimen stabilization down to the picometre scale was achieved allowing drift-corrected atomic-resolution imaging. Specimen stage-based stabilization significantly improves long-exposure imaging and in situ experiments by increasing the effective exposure time, preserving the field of view, maintaining identical optical conditions and eliminating the need for numerical alignment of large datasets. Beyond the specific application presented here, dynamic control provides a versatile framework for real-time regulation of electron microscopy experiments and opens new perspectives for quantitative imaging, automated in situ studies and multimodal acquisitions.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为"动态控制"的通用实时反馈框架，通过主动控制显微镜载物台来补偿样品漂移，精度可达皮米级，无需硬件修改即可在TEM和STEM等多种仪器上实现漂移校正的原子分辨率成像。
AI.motivation: 电子显微镜中的样品漂移是影响长曝光成像和原位实验的主要问题之一，传统方法依赖数值后处理对齐，不仅耗时且无法保持原始光学条件。作者希望开发一种主动、实时的漂移补偿方案。
AI.method: 提出动态控制框架：从探测器数据流中持续监测实验变量（如样品漂移），并通过控制载物台实时补偿其演化。该框架包含自动化校准程序，与图像采集并行运行，以软件插件形式实现，无需任何硬件改动。
AI.result: 在多种TEM和STEM仪器（包括传统机械载物台和压电载物台）上实现了实时漂移校正。使用压电载物台时，样品稳定精度达到皮米级，实现了漂移校正的原子分辨率成像。覆盖中分辨率TEM、高分辨TEM、HR-STEM和原位观察等多种实验场景。
AI.conclusion: 基于载物台的稳定化显著改善了长曝光成像和原位实验：增加有效曝光时间、保持视野、维持相同光学条件、消除大数据集数值对齐需求。动态控制框架为电子显微镜实时调控提供了通用解决方案，开启了定量成像、自动化原位研究和多模态采集的新前景。

title: Vector-field control and emergent basal-plane anisotropy of magnetic textures in noncentrosymmetric (Fe$_{0.63}$Ni$_{0.3}$Pd$_{0.07}$)$_3$P
summary: (Fe$_{0.63}$Ni$_{0.3}$Pd$_{0.07}$)$_3$P is a room-temperature magnet with $S_4$ symmetry that hosts a rich variety of topological spin textures. Here, we report a combined resonant small-angle x-ray scattering and ptychography study of (Fe$_{0.63}$Ni$_{0.3}$Pd$_{0.07}$)$_3$P in vector magnetic fields over a broad temperature range. We demonstrate deterministic vector-field control of magnetic stripe domains, where in-plane fields continuously rotate their orientation via a transition from a chiral stripe to an achiral fan configuration. Furthermore, at 50 K and below, the stripe orientation becomes metastably pinned and retains its field-trained direction. While the magnitude of the wavevector is nearly isotropic within the basal plane at room temperature, a pronounced temperature evolution of anisotropic interactions emerges upon cooling. In particular, non-trivial anisotropy axes develop at 20-50 K reflecting the combined effects of magnetocrystalline anisotropy, anisotropic exchange, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI), whose effective orientation is found to rotate with temperature. These results establish (Fe$_{0.63}$Ni$_{0.3}$Pd$_{0.07}$)$_3$P as a model system for vector-field control of chiral spin textures and reveal a previously unrecognized temperature-driven evolution of the effective DMI landscape in a noncentrosymmetric magnet.

AI.tldr: 本文通过共振小角X射线散射和叠层衍射成像技术，在矢量磁场和宽温度范围内研究了(Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P这一室温磁性材料中的拓扑自旋织构，展示了确定性矢量场控制磁条纹畴方向的能力，并揭示了温度驱动的有效DMI（Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用）景观演化。
AI.motivation: 该材料具有S₄对称性和丰富的拓扑自旋织构，是研究手性磁体中自旋织构调控的理想平台。理解矢量磁场对磁畴的控制机制以及温度对相互作用各向异性的影响，对开发基于拓扑自旋织构的自旋电子学器件具有重要意义。
AI.method: 结合共振小角X射线散射（resonant SAXS）和叠层衍射成像（ptychography）两种同步辐射技术，在矢量磁场条件下对(Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P样品进行宽温度范围（从室温到低温）的系统表征。
AI.result: 1）实现了矢量场对磁条纹畴的确定性控制，面内磁场通过手性条纹到非手性扇构型转变连续旋转条纹取向；2）50 K以下条纹取向被亚稳钉扎，保持场训练方向；3）室温下波矢在基面内近似各向同性，但降温后出现显著的各向异性相互作用演化；4）20-50 K出现非平凡的各向异性轴，反映磁晶各向异性、各向异性交换和DMI的联合效应，且有效DMI取向随温度旋转。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立(Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P作为矢量场控制手性自旋织构的模型体系，并揭示了非中心对称磁体中此前未被认识到的温度驱动有效DMI景观演化。

title: Kappa distributions as asymptotic marginals of exponential family ensembles
summary: Recently (Physica A 660 130370, 2025), emergence of superstatistical behavior in driven classical systems has been shown for systems with constant microcanonical heat capacity. As an application of this result, in this work we show that a system of $N$ particles with inverse gamma distribution of total kinetic energies must have kappa-distributed single-particle velocities in the limit $N \rightarrow \infty$. Our results provide insight into the nature of kappa distributions outside the theory of nonextensive statistical mechanics, while also bringing forward a practical method for the generation of kappa velocities via Monte Carlo Metropolis simulation in the inverse gamma ensemble.

AI.tldr: 本文基于近期超统计行为在受驱经典系统中的研究成果，证明当总动能服从逆伽马分布时，在N趋于无穷的极限下，单粒子速度服从kappa分布。该结果为kappa分布提供了非广延统计力学之外的理论解释，并提出了一种通过逆伽马系综的蒙特卡洛Metropolis模拟生成kappa速度的实用方法。
AI.motivation: 在此之前，kappa分布通常与非广延统计力学相关联。本文旨在探讨kappa分布是否能在其他理论框架下自然涌现，从而为kappa分布的本质提供新的见解，同时发展实用的数值生成方法。
AI.method: 利用超统计（superstatistics）理论框架：当系统总动能服从逆伽马分布时，推导单粒子速度分布在N→∞极限下的形式，证明其收敛为kappa分布。同时提出在逆伽马系综中使用蒙特卡洛Metropolis模拟来生成kappa分布速度的实用算法。
AI.result: 证明了N粒子系统在总动能服从逆伽马分布时，单粒子速度在热力学极限下必然呈现kappa分布。这一结果验证了超统计方法可以自然产生kappa分布，而不需要诉诸非广延统计力学。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从超统计视角重新解释了kappa分布的起源，并为实际模拟中高效生成kappa分布速度提供了可行方法，具有理论和计算双重价值。

title: Negative Differential Capacitance from Composition-Dependent Stern Capacitance in a Binary Mixture
summary: We develop a thermodynamic theory of electric double layers in binary liquid mixtures by allowing the Stern-layer capacitance to depend on the local solvent composition. This coupling produces an additional negative contribution to the inverse differential capacitance. As a result, the surface potential can become a nonmonotonic function of the surface charge density, leading to negative differential capacitance and a voltage-induced first-order transition between two electric-double-layer states. We determine the coexistence condition using a common-tangent construction for the surface-charge-controlled grand potential and obtain phase diagrams in terms of the Stern-capacitance contrast, surface charge density, bulk composition, and surface potential. We also compare the theory with capacitance data for tetrabutylammonium chloride in water/1-propanol mixtures, finding semi-quantitative agreement in the continuous-response regime. These results suggest that solvent exchange inside the Stern layer can strongly control the capacitance and interfacial phase behavior of binary mixtures.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一个二元液体混合物中双电层的热力学理论，通过允许Stern层电容依赖于局部溶剂组成，揭示了该耦合如何导致负微分电容和电压诱导的一阶相变，并与实验数据进行了半定量比较。
AI.motivation: 二元液体混合物中的双电层行为（特别是Stern层中溶剂交换对电容和界面相行为的影响）尚未被充分理解。作者旨在建立一个能够解释溶剂组成耦合效应的热力学理论框架。
AI.method: 建立热力学理论，允许Stern层电容依赖于局部溶剂组成。通过表面电荷控制的巨势的公共切线构造确定共存条件，并绘制以Stern电容对比度、表面电荷密度、体相组成和表面电位为参数的相图。将理论预测与四丁基氯化铵在水/1-丙醇混合物中的电容数据进行比较。
AI.result: 该耦合产生了对逆微分电容的额外负贡献，导致表面电位成为表面电荷密度的非单调函数，从而出现负微分电容和电压诱导的一阶跃迁。理论与实验数据在连续响应区域获得半定量一致。
AI.conclusion: Stern层内的溶剂交换能够强烈控制二元混合物的电容和界面相行为，这对理解二元电解质体系的电化学界面性质具有重要意义。

title: Magnetoresistance in Magnetic Weyl semimetal Mn$_{3}$ZnC
summary: The magnetoresistance (MR) in magnetic materials reveal an intriguing spin-dependent electron scattering, highlighting the role of spin polarization on the electronic transport properties. This becomes even more interesting for the topological magnetic materials where a finite Berry curvature leads to an intrinsic scattering channel also. In this report, we investigate MR of Mn$_{3}$ZnC, an antiperovskite magnetic nodal line semimetal. Mn$_{3}$ZnC shows a ferromagnetic (FM) transition at $\sim$ 420 K, followed by an ferrimagnetic (FIM) transition at $\sim$ 195 K. We focus on the interpretation of MR data and highlight the relation between MR and its magnetization. The signature of magnetization induced MR shows correlation at low magnetic fields and displays distinct behaviors in the FIM and FM states. Similar to the isothermal magnetization M(H) curve of FM and FIM state, the MR curves exhibit a sharp increase, followed by a linear behavior at higher fields. As the magnetic field varies, the cusp-like anomaly becomes more pronounced, and vanishes at the magnetic phase transition, which then reappears as the temperature increases. The sign change in the MR curves in the FIM state is attributed to a drastic change in the carrier mobility. Interestingly, this system shows a positive MR in FM state at very low field, which is quite unusual.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了反钙钛矿磁性节线半金属Mn₃ZnC的磁电阻（MR）行为，发现其MR与磁化强度密切相关，在铁磁（FM）和亚铁磁（FIM）态表现出不同特征，并观察到非常规的低温正磁电阻现象。
AI.motivation: 磁性材料中的磁电阻揭示了自旋相关电子散射的物理机制，而拓扑磁性材料中有限的Berry曲率提供了额外的本征散射通道，使该问题更具研究价值。理解MR与磁化强度之间的关系对于揭示拓扑磁性材料中的电子输运性质具有重要意义。
AI.method: 对Mn₃ZnC反钙钛矿磁性节线半金属进行系统的磁电阻测量，重点分析其MR数据与磁化强度之间的关联，比较FM态（~420 K以下）和FIM态（~195 K以下）中MR曲线的不同行为特征，并结合等温磁化M(H)曲线进行对比分析。
AI.result: 发现MR与磁化强度在低磁场下具有相关性；FM态和FIM态的MR曲线呈现先急剧增加后线性增加的规律，与M(H)曲线类似；尖峰状异常在磁场变化时更为明显，在磁相变温度处消失，随后随温度升高重新出现；FIM态中MR的符号变化归因于载流子迁移率的剧烈改变；FM态在极低磁场下表现出不寻常的正MR。
AI.conclusion: Mn₃ZnC的磁电阻行为与其磁态密切相关，揭示了FM态中罕见的低温正磁电阻现象以及FIM态中由载流子迁移率变化引起的MR符号翻转，为理解反钙钛矿磁性拓扑材料中的自旋相关输运性质提供了新的见解。

title: Alloy engineering of excitonic properties in TMD monolayers
summary: We investigate monolayer MoS$_{2x}$Se$_{2(1-x)}$ alloys across the full composition range using optical spectroscopy. We demonstrate continuous tuning of the optical gap over $\sim$0.35 eV, accompanied by a systematic reduction of the B--A exciton splitting, in agreement with density functional theory calculations. Temperature-dependent measurements reveal a progressive increase of the average phonon energy from Se-rich to S-rich alloys that follows a simple reduced-mass scaling model. Polarization-resolved spectroscopy further shows a monotonic increase of the circular polarization from nearly zero in MoSe$_2$ to $\sim$15\% in MoS$_2$ at 78 K. The observed evolution of the polarization is attributed to alloy-induced modifications of the electronic structure that modify bright--dark exciton mixing and the associated valley depolarization. These findings establish alloy engineering as an effective strategy for controlling excitonic properties in TMD monolayers.

AI.tldr: 本论文系统研究了单层MoS₂ₓSe₂₍₁₋ₓ₎合金在整个组分范围内的光学性质。研究发现，通过调节Se/S比例，可连续调控光学带隙约0.35 eV，并伴随B-A激子分裂的系统性减小（与DFT计算一致）。变温测量揭示了从富Se到富S合金中平均声子能量渐进增加的趋势，符合简单的约化质量标度模型。偏振分辨光谱显示，在78 K下圆形偏振度从MoSe₂的接近零单调增加到MoS₂的约15%，该演化归因于合金诱导的电子结构改变，影响了亮-暗激子混合及相关谷退极化。研究确立了合金工程作为调控TMD单层激子性质的有效策略。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）单层具有独特的谷电子学和强激子效应，但其光学和谷性质的可调控性受限。合金化作为一类新兴的调控手段，其在整个组分范围内对光学带隙、激子分裂、声子相互作用和谷极化的系统影响尚未被全面揭示，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用光学光谱学方法（包括变温光谱和偏振分辨光谱）对单层MoS₂ₓSe₂₍₁₋ₓ₎合金进行系统表征，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算进行对比验证。
AI.result: 成功实现了光学带隙的连续调谐（~0.35 eV），观察到B-A激子分裂的系统性减小；平均声子能量随S含量增加而增大，符合约化质量标度模型；圆形偏振度从MoSe₂的近零单调增至MoS₂的~15%（78 K），定量揭示了合金组分对谷极化的调控作用。
AI.conclusion: 合金工程可作为有效策略来系统调控TMD单层的激子带隙、激子分裂及谷极化等光学性质，为基于合金TMD材料的光电器件和谷电子学应用奠定了物理基础。

title: Enhancement of far-field thermal emission via polaritonic cavity modes
summary: Controlling thermal emission is crucial for applications involving thermophotovoltaics, thermal sensing, imaging, and camouflage. While prior studies focused on the emission of thermally excited guided modes (TEGMs) inside cavities, their contribution to the far-field radiation outside cavities has remained unexplored. Here, we demonstrate a tunable far-field thermal channel enabled by TEGMs arising from the coupling of surface phonon-polaritons and cavity resonances. By combining infrared emissivity experiments with fluctuational electrodynamics simulations, we identify distinct spectral features marking the conversion of two-dimensionally confined polaritonic modes into three-dimensional radiative channels. We find that silicon cavities covered with SiO2 enhance the emissivity by up to 200% near the polaritonic spectral resonance, whereas bare silicon cavities yield only broadband enhancement. These findings provide experimental evidence of TEGMs and establish a simple cavity architecture as an effective and scalable platform for tailoring thermal radiation without complex nanofabrication.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了由表面声子极化激元与腔共振耦合产生的热激发导模（TEGMs）可实现可调谐的远场热辐射通道。实验表明，覆盖SiO2的硅腔在极化激元谱共振附近将发射率提升高达200%，而裸硅腔仅产生宽带增强，为远场热辐射调控提供了简单可扩展的平台。
AI.motivation: 热辐射控制在热光伏、热传感、成像和伪装等应用中至关重要。以往研究聚焦于腔体内TEGMs的发射，但对其在腔外远场辐射中的贡献尚未探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，并探索简单腔结构调控热辐射的可能性。
AI.method: 结合红外发射率实验与涨落电动力学模拟，研究Si腔覆盖SiO2层的结构中TEGMs的远场辐射特性。通过分析发射光谱识别二维受限极化激元模式向三维辐射通道转换的光谱特征。
AI.result: 硅腔覆盖SiO2可在极化激元谱共振附近将发射率提升高达200%，而裸硅腔仅产生宽带增强。实验结果首次提供了TEGMs的实验证据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了简单腔架构作为有效且可扩展的热辐射调控平台，无需复杂纳米加工即可实现热辐射定制，同时为TEGMs在远场辐射中的作用提供了实验验证。

title: TNASS: Tensor Network Active Space Selection with the Entanglement Feature
summary: The quality of multi-scale modelling techniques in molecular electronic structure calculations, such as embedding and subspace methods, relies upon the chosen active space. The automation of active space selection is vital for ensuring the accuracy, reproducibility, and scalability in such calculations. In this work, we introduce Tensor Network Active Space Selection using the Entanglement Feature. Through the isolation of strongly correlated electrons, this method provides a scalable foundation for embedding methods in multi-scale modelling. By representing the purities of all possible orbital partitions as a Matrix Product State, our method isolates regions of strong electron correlation without requiring manual preselection of target atoms or the calculation of expensive high-order density matrices. The results demonstrate that this approach leads to lower ground state energies and more accurate dipole moments than other fully automated selection schemes such as those based solely on single-orbital entropy or the selection of spatial orbitals around the HOMO/LUMO gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于纠缠特征的张量网络活性空间选择方法（Tensor Network Active Space Selection using the Entanglement Feature），通过将轨道划分的纯度表示为矩阵乘积态来隔离强关联电子区域，无需人工预选目标原子或计算高阶密度矩阵，从而为多尺度建模中的嵌入方法提供可扩展的基础。
AI.motivation: 多尺度建模技术（如嵌入和子空间方法）的质量依赖于所选活性空间，而活性空间选择的自动化对于确保此类计算的准确性、可重复性和可扩展性至关重要。现有的全自动选择方案存在不足，需要更优的方法。
AI.method: 该方法通过将所有可能轨道划分的纯度表示为矩阵乘积态（Matrix Product State），利用纠缠特征来隔离强相关电子区域，无需人工预选目标原子或计算昂贵的高阶密度矩阵。
AI.result: 与仅基于单轨道熵或基于HOMO/LUMO能隙附近空间轨道选择的全自动方案相比，该方法能获得更低的基态能量和更精确的偶极矩。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多尺度建模中的嵌入方法提供了一个可扩展的活性空间选择基础，能够有效隔离强关联电子区域，提升计算精度。

title: Manipulation of localized excitons in CrPS$_4$ by temperature and magnetic field
summary: Layered van der Waals magnetic semiconductors provide a versatile platform for exploring excitonic phenomena intertwined with spin and lattice degrees of freedom, enabling excitons to act as sensitive probes of magnetic order. CrPS$_4$ is a layered antiferromagnetic semiconductor that hosts rich excitonic features whose microscopic origin and connection to magnetic ordering remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigate the electronic and excitonic properties of bulk CrPS$_4$ using a combination of many-body perturbation theory, dynamical mean-field theory, and photoluminescence-based experiments. Our calculations establish CrPS$_4$ as a direct-gap semiconductor with a bandgap of 2.48~eV in the antiferromagnetic phase. Several sub-bandgap excitonic transitions are predicted by theory, comprising multiple spin-allowed excitons and an additional spin-flip excitation, predominantly localized on the Cr$^{3+}$ ions. Temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent optical measurements reveal thermally driven exciton redistribution among localized states and identify characteristic energy shifts that provide clear optical signatures of magnetic phase transitions in CrPS$_4$. These results provide new insights into the excitonic transitions of antiferromagnets and suggest potential routes for all-optical sensing and light-driven control of their magnetic order.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多体微扰理论、动力学平均场理论和光致发光实验相结合，系统研究了块体CrPS₄的电子和激子性质，揭示了其反铁磁相中的直接带隙（2.48 eV）及多种亚带隙激子跃迁，并通过温度与磁场依赖的光学测量识别出磁相变的光学特征。
AI.motivation: CrPS₄作为层状反铁磁半导体，其丰富的激子特征与磁有序之间的微观联系尚未被完全理解，需要深入阐明激子跃迁的起源及其与磁性相互作用的机制。
AI.method: 结合多体微扰理论（many-body perturbation theory）、动力学平均场理论（DMFT）和光致发光（photoluminescence）实验，对块体CrPS₄的电子结构和激子性质进行理论预测与实验验证。
AI.result: 确立CrPS₄为反铁磁相中的直接带隙半导体（带隙2.48 eV）；理论预测了多个亚带隙激子跃迁，包括自旋允许激子和自旋翻转激子（主要局域于Cr³⁺离子）；温度与磁场依赖的光学测量揭示了热驱动激子再分布，并识别出磁相变的特征能量位移。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为反铁磁体的激子跃迁提供了新见解，并暗示了全光学传感和光驱动控制磁有序的潜在途径。

title: Magnetic and crystal electric field excitations in a spin-orbit coupled frustrated hyperkagome magnet Nd$_3$Li$_3$W$_2$O$_{12}$
summary: Rare-earth based garnets provide a viable platform for studying the frustrated driven magnetic properties of the hyperkagome lattices. Herein, we report a comprehensive study of the magnetic properties and crystal electric field (CEF) scheme of a new Nd$^{3+}$ based hyperkagome antiferromagnet, Nd$_3$Li$_3$W$_2$O$_{12}$ belonging to the garnet family via magnetization, heat capacity, and inelastic neutron scattering (INS) measurements. Magnetization measurement reveals a dominant antiferromagnetic interaction with a low temperature Curie-Weiss temperature $θ_{\rm CW}^{\rm LT} \simeq -0.2$ K. Two broad maxima are observed in the magnetic heat capacity data under magnetic fields, implying multilevel Schottky anomalies due to the effect of CEF and display a two-step magnetic entropy release. No magnetic long-range order is observed down to 0.1 K. The CEF excitations of the Nd$^{3+}$ ($J=9/2$) ion with $D_2$ point group symmetry, probed via INS experiments, show non-dispersive excitations characterizing the transitions among the CEF energy levels. The simultaneous fit of the INS spectra at different temperatures enabled the mapping of the CEF Hamiltonian and the energy eigenvalues of the Kramers' doublets. The simulation using the obtained CEF parameters reproduces the experimental magnetic susceptibility, magnetic isotherms, and magnetic heat capacity data. The thermodynamic properties and INS-derived crystal-field scheme confirm a Kramers' doublet ground state with an effective spin $J_{\rm eff} = 1/2$ at low temperatures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过磁化率、比热和非弹性中子散射等实验，系统研究了新型Nd³⁺基hyperkagome反铁磁体Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂的磁性及晶场能级结构，确认其低温下具有J_eff=1/2的Kramers二重态基态。
AI.motivation: 稀土基石榴石为研究hyperkagome晶格中受挫驱动磁性质提供了可行平台，作者旨在探索一种新的Nd³⁺基hyperkagome反铁磁体，揭示其磁性质和晶场（CEF）方案。
AI.method: 采用磁化率、热容和非弹性中子散射（INS）三种实验手段，并结合对INS谱在不同温度下的同时拟合，建立了CEF哈密顿量模型并映射出Kramers二重态的能量本征值。
AI.result: 磁化率显示以低温居里-外斯温度θ_CW≈-0.2K为主导的反铁磁相互作用；磁场下磁比热出现两个宽峰，对应多能级Schottky异常并呈现两步磁熵释放；0.1K以下无磁长程有序；INS显示非色散激发的CEF能级跃迁，模拟结果与实验数据（磁化率、磁等温线、磁比热）一致。
AI.conclusion: 热力学性质与INS导出的晶场方案共同确认该材料在低温下具有J_eff=1/2的Kramers二重态基态，为研究hyperkagome受挫磁体提供了新的实验平台。

title: Machine Learning Bandgap Prediction of Nanoporous Graphenes with Water
summary: The structure and dynamical behavior of water confined at or within nanostructures is a topic central to many fields, from biology to emerging electronics such as carbon nanostructures. Nanoporous graphene (NPG) containing periodic nanoscale pores with specific topologies has emerged as a promising material in carbon-based nanoelectronics; however, its interaction with ambient water remains poorly understood. Here, we combine density functional theory (DFT), ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD), and interpretable machine learning (ML) to reveal how water controls quantum transport in NPGs. Depending on the local hydration structure, the bandgap varies by more than a factor of two across NPG and nitrogen-doped hybrid (h-NPG) systems. To uncover the underlying mechanism, we develop Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP)-based black-box and physics-informed grey-box ML models. The Gaussian process regression model achieves near-DFT accuracy while enabling physical interpretation. Analysis identifies water dipole orientation, water-substrate distance, water center-of-geometry, and ribbon-resolved dipole moments as the dominant factors controlling bandgap modulation across NPG and h-NPG systems.

AI.tldr: 本文结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、从头算分子动力学（AIMD）和可解释机器学习（ML），研究了受限水如何调控纳米多孔石墨烯（NPG）的量子输运性质，发现带隙随局部水合结构变化可超过两倍，并通过SOAP-based机器学习模型识别出水偶极取向、水-基底距离等关键控制因素。
AI.motivation: 纳米多孔石墨烯在碳基纳米电子学中具有广阔应用前景，但其与环境水的相互作用机制尚不明确，水对量子输运的影响缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 结合DFT、AIMD和可解释机器学习的方法。开发了基于Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions（SOAP）的黑箱高斯过程回归模型和物理信息驱动的灰箱模型，用于预测和分析带隙调制。
AI.result: 高斯过程回归模型达到了接近DFT的精度，同时实现了物理可解释性。识别出水偶极取向、水-基底距离、水几何中心和条带分辨偶极矩是控制NPG和h-NPG系统带隙调制的主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 水对NPG量子输运具有显著影响，带隙变化超过两倍；通过物理信息机器学习模型成功揭示了水调控带隙的微观机制，为纳米多孔碳材料在湿环境下的电子器件设计提供了理论指导。

title: High-Order Response Functions with Duschinsky Coupling and Finite Temperature: Application to Two-Dimensional Resonance Raman Spectroscopy
summary: In this work, we derive closed-form expressions for multi-time correlation functions underlying higher-order nonlinear spectroscopic response functions within the harmonic approximation. Our method includes displacements, frequency changes, and Duschinsky rotation between the vibrational modes of different electronic states while retaining polynomial scaling with the number of degrees of freedom. Finite temperature is accounted for without summation over vibrational eigenstates. To show the capabilities of our method, we apply it to calculate fifth-order two-dimensional resonance Raman (2DRR) spectra of two-mode model systems and naphthalene. Comparison with the displaced harmonic oscillator model shows that Duschinsky rotation modifies the positions and relative intensities of diagonal and cross peaks. Overall, our results demonstrate that 2DRR spectroscopy is particularly sensitive to changes in normal coordinates between electronic states and can provide distinct signatures of Duschinsky coupling in molecular systems.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了谐振子近似下高阶非线性光谱响应函数所对应的多时间关联函数的闭式表达式，该方法包含了位移、频率变化以及Duschinsky旋转效应，计算复杂度随自由度呈多项式增长，且无需对振动本征态求和即可考虑有限温度效应。作者将该方法应用于双模模型体系和萘的五阶二维共振拉曼（2DRR）光谱计算，通过与位移谐振子模型对比发现Duschinsky旋转会改变对角峰和交叉峰的位置及相对强度，表明2DRR光谱对电子态间正则坐标的变化特别敏感，可为分子体系中Duschinsky耦合提供独特的光谱指纹。
AI.motivation: 高阶非线性光谱（如五阶二维共振拉曼光谱）能够提供超越传统线性光谱的分子结构和动力学信息，但计算这些光谱需要处理多时间关联函数，其数值求解通常面临巨大的计算成本。现有方法往往忽略Duschinsky旋转效应或依赖于振动本征态求和，难以高效且准确地处理实际分子体系。
AI.method: 在谐振子近似下，推导了高阶非线性光谱响应函数对应的多时间关联函数的闭式解析表达式。该方法可以同时涵盖三个关键效应：振动态之间的位移、频率变化以及Duschinsky旋转，同时计算复杂度仅随自由度数量呈多项式增长。有限温度效应通过解析方式处理，无需对各振动本征态进行显式求和。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于双模模型体系和萘分子的五阶二维共振拉曼（2DRR）光谱计算。与位移谐振子模型（不含Duschinsky旋转）的对比表明，Duschinsky旋转会显著改变二维光谱中对角峰和交叉峰的位置及相对强度。
AI.conclusion: 2DRR光谱对电子态之间正则坐标的变化高度敏感，能够提供Duschinsky耦合在分子体系中的独特光谱特征，为实验研究分子激发态的结构变化提供了理论工具和预测依据。

title: Emergence and Detection of Surface altermagnetism in KV$_2$Se$_2$O
summary: We demonstrate the recent concept of emergent surface altermagnetism through its unique signatures in \KVSO. We show that for bulk antiferromagnetically ordered \KVSO, the (001) surface exhibits $d$-wave altermagnetism. Our results fully explain the recent seemingly contradicgting experimental evidence, independently showing both an antiferromagnetically ordered bulk from neutron diffraction, and $d$-wave spin splitting from photoemission spectroscopy. To fully verify this conecept, we predict, as a key experimental signature, a large nonlinear Edelstein response, which is localized at the surface, and follows the $d$-wave altermagnetic symmetry. These results are not only relevant for the metallic and room-temperature magnet \KVSO, but also for several other Lieb lattice systems. Our work expands the pool of techniques that can be used to detect altermagnetism emerging at the surfaces of antiferromagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了体态反铁磁KVSb化合物中的(001)表面表现出d波交替磁性（altermagnetism），统一解释了中子衍射（反铁磁体态）与光电子能谱（d波自旋劈裂）之间看似矛盾的实验结果，并预测了一个局域于表面的、遵循d波交替磁对称性的非线性Edelstein响应作为关键实验特征。
AI.motivation: 实验上观察到KVSb体态呈反铁磁有序（中子衍射）而表面表现出d波自旋劈裂（光电子能谱），二者看似矛盾。作者提出表面的涌现交替磁性（emergent surface altermagnetism）概念来解释这一现象，并希望进一步验证和推广该概念。
AI.method: 通过理论计算/第一性原理证明：(1) 体态反铁磁有序的KVSb其(001)表面展现出d波交替磁性；(2) 基于此预测一个大面积非线性Edelstein响应，该响应局域于表面且遵循d波交替磁对称性，可作为验证该概念的关键实验探针。
AI.result: 成功解释了矛盾实验数据，并预测了表面局域、遵循d波对称性的强非线性Edelstein响应作为验证交替磁性的关键实验信号；该结论不仅适用于KVSb，还推广到其他Lieb格子体系。
AI.conclusion: 表面涌现交替磁性是反铁磁体表面探测的重要新框架，扩展了探测反铁磁材料表面交替磁性的技术手段。

title: Anisotropic Phonon Heat Flow and Thermoelectric Response in Tetragonal GeS$_2$ and GeSe$_2$
comment: 31 pages, 25 figures, and 6 tables. Includes supplementary information
summary:
The electronic structure, lattice dynamics, bonding, elastic response, and anisotropic thermoelectric transport properties of tetragonal GeS$_2$ and GeSe$_2$ were investigated using density functional theory, density functional perturbation theory, Wannier interpolation, and scattering-aware Boltzmann transport. The relaxed structures are mechanically and dynamically stable within the calculated harmonic description. The HSE03/Wannier band gaps are 2.48 eV for GeS$_2$ and 1.23 eV for GeSe$_2$, while substitution of S by Se lowers the upper phonon frequency from approximately 13.6 to 10.3 THz.
  The phonon Boltzmann transport calculations reveal pronounced lattice-transport anisotropy. Within the relaxation-time approximation, the 300 K in-plane and cross-plane lattice thermal conductivities are 26.86 and 1.19 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ for GeS$_2$, and 18.74 and 1.52 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ for GeSe$_2$, respectively. At 800 K, these values decrease to 10.22 and 0.46 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ for GeS$_2$, and 7.25 and 0.58 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ for GeSe$_2$. Frequency-resolved analysis shows that low-frequency phonons carry most of the heat, whereas the small cross-plane values reflect restricted out-of-plane phonon transport.
  Combining the ShengBTE RTA lattice tensors with AMSET electronic coefficients gives $zT=0.257$ for n-type cross-plane GeS$_2$ at 800 K and $10^{19}$ cm$^{-3}$. The corresponding PBE-AMSET estimate for GeSe$_2$ is $zT=0.066$ for p-type cross-plane transport at 800 K and $3\times10^{20}$ cm$^{-3}$. LOBSTER analysis identifies mixed covalent--ionic Ge--X bonding, with Ge--S bonds having a larger stabilizing ICOHP magnitude than Ge--Se bonds ($-5.27$ versus $-4.74$ eV per bond). These results identify tetragonal GeX$_2$ compounds as strongly anisotropic thermoelectrics with moderate calculated $zT$ values whose cross-plane response benefits from suppressed lattice heat transport.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DFT、DFPT、Wannier插值和声子Boltzmann输运理论，系统研究了四方GeS₂和GeSe₂的电子结构、晶格动力学、成键、弹性响应及各向异性热电输运性质。发现这两种材料具有显著的晶格热导率各向异性（面内vs跨面的热导率差异达20倍以上），跨面zT值在800K时可达0.257（n型GeS₂），被鉴定为强各向异性热电材料。
AI.motivation: 探索具有强各向异性热电输运性质的新型材料，特别是寻找跨面方向具有低晶格热导率从而提升热电优值（zT）的候选材料。GeX₂（X=S, Se）四方相材料此前缺乏系统的热电输运性质研究。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）、Wannier插值、散射感知的Boltzmann输运理论；使用HSE03杂化泛函计算带隙；利用ShengBTE（RTA）计算晶格热导率，AMSET计算电子输运系数；使用LOBSTER进行化学成键分析（COHP/ICOHP）。
AI.result: GeS₂和GeSe₂的HSE03带隙分别为2.48 eV和1.23 eV；S替换为Se使最高声子频率从13.6降至10.3 THz。300K时面内/跨面晶格热导率：GeS₂为26.86/1.19 W m⁻¹K⁻¹，GeSe₂为18.74/1.52 W m⁻¹K⁻¹；800K时分别降至10.22/0.46和7.25/0.58 W m⁻¹K⁻¹。低频声子主导热输运，跨面方向声子输运受限。800K时n型跨面GeS₂的zT=0.257（10¹⁹ cm⁻³），p型跨面GeSe₂的zT=0.066（3×10²⁰ cm⁻³）。Ge-S键的ICOHP（-5.27 eV/键）大于Ge-Se键（-4.74 eV/键），表明共价-离子混合成键特征。
AI.conclusion: 四方GeX₂化合物被鉴定为强各向异性热电材料，跨面方向因晶格热导率显著抑制而获得有利的热电性能（中等zT值）。Ge-S比Ge-Se键具有更强的稳定化作用，Se替代S降低了带隙和声子频率。这类材料有望在跨面方向上获得更好的热电应用前景。

title: Controllable interaction between photons and distant spins via vacuum Rabi oscillations
summary: Vacuum Rabi oscillations between a single photon and a single spin demonstrate the capability of harnessing light-matter interaction at the level of a single quantum of energy. Since the observation of strong spin-photon coupling in gate-defined quantum dots, probing this interaction in the time-domain has been a major objective. Here, we carefully engineer a device composed of two spatially separated double quantum dots hosting single electron spin qubits and a superconducting cavity to accommodate microwave photons. We observe multiple vacuum Rabi oscillations between each spin qubit and the cavity. By concatenating vacuum Rabi oscillations involving the two spins, an energy excitation in one qubit can be emitted as a photon and then transferred to the other qubit. When a single photon is emitted, the cavity is prepared in a Fock state, leading to an accelerated vacuum Rabi frequency. These results serve as building blocks not only in exploring light-matter interactions, but also in interfacing semiconductor spin qubits to photonic links.

AI.tldr: 本文在双量子点自旋量子比特与超导腔耦合的器件中，首次在时域上观测到多个真空拉比振荡，并利用光子实现两个自旋量子比特之间的能量转移，制备Fock态，为半导体自旋量子比特的光子接口奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 强自旋-光子耦合已在门定义量子点中被观测到，但在时域上探测这种相互作用一直是重要目标，因为时域特征（如真空拉比振荡）是量子相干操控和量子信息处理的关键前提。
AI.method: 精心设计一个由两个空间分离的双量子点（各含单电子自旋量子比特）与超导腔组成的器件；通过让每个自旋量子比特与腔发生耦合，观测多个真空拉比振荡；通过将涉及两个自旋的真空拉比振荡串联，实现一个量子比特的激发能通过光子发射并转移至另一个量子比特。
AI.result: 观测到每个自旋量子比特与超导腔之间的多个真空拉比振荡；成功通过单光子实现两个自旋量子比特间的能量传递；单光子发射后腔处于Fock态，且真空拉比频率出现加速现象。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果不仅为探索光-物质相互作用提供了构建模块，也为将半导体自旋量子比特与光子链路接口化开辟了道路。

title: A variational hybrid continuous-variable discrete-variable quantum algorithm for adiabatic nuclear dynamics
summary: Gaussian wavepacket (GWP) methods are prevalent means of solving the nuclear time-dependent Schrodinger equation (TDSE) on classical computers. They consist of representing the nuclear wave function as a superposition of Gaussians. Here, we present a variational hybrid continuous-variable discrete-variable (CV-DV) algorithm for simulating adiabatic nuclear dynamics on qubit-oscillator quantum hardware. It encodes a superposition of frozen Gaussians (FGs) onto the qubit-oscillator register and evolves it according to the time-dependent variational principle (VP). We test two variants of the approach, one that evolves a single FG and another that evolves a superposition of FGs, on a set of prototypical 1D harmonic and anharmonic systems. We simulate the photoexcited state dynamics of SO2 using the single FG variant of the algorithm and compute its autocorrelation function on physical quantum hardware. For harmonic and Morse potentials, the variant evolving the superposition of FGs converges to the numerically exact solution as the number of Gaussians increases. In the case of the double-well potential, the algorithm simulates wavepacket bifurcation and recurrence correctly, and the ensuing irregular dynamics moderately well. Overall, this work establishes a pathway for simulating molecular dynamics on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于在量子硬件上模拟绝热核动力学的变分混合连续变量-离散变量（CV-DV）算法，将冻结高斯波包叠加编码到量子比特-振荡器寄存器上，并通过时间相关变分原理进行演化，在多种一维谐振和非谐振系统上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 高斯波包方法是经典计算机上求解含时薛定谔方程的常用手段，但传统方法在经典硬件上存在计算瓶颈。随着噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备的发展，需要探索在量子硬件上模拟分子动力学的新途径，以克服经典计算在复杂分子体系模拟中的指数级开销。
AI.method: 提出一种变分混合CV-DV算法，将冻结高斯波包的叠加态编码到量子比特-振荡器（qubit-oscillator）寄存器上，利用时间相关变分原理（TDVP）进行演化。算法包含两种变体：单FG演化变体和FG叠加演化变体，并在1D谐振及非谐振势阱系统上进行测试。
AI.result: 在谐振和Morse势下，FG叠加变体随高斯数增加收敛到数值精确解；在双阱势下正确模拟了波包分叉和重现现象，对不规则动力学也有中等程度的模拟效果。同时，在物理量子硬件上成功模拟了SO2的光激发态动力学并计算了自相关函数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在NISQ设备上模拟分子动力学开辟了可行路径，展示了混合量子-经典框架在量子化学动力学模拟中的潜力。

title: Microscopic Origin of Random Singlet Behavior in B-site Disordered Spin-1/2 Perovskite BaCu_1/3Nb_2/3O_3 Revealed by EXAFS and Thermodynamics
summary: We report a combined structural and thermodynamic study of the ABO$_3$-type disordered perovskite BaCu$_{1/3}$Nb$_{2/3}$O$_3$ (BCNO), whose B site is jointly occupied by Cu and Nb in the $1:2$ ratio. Using synchrotron powder x-ray diffraction (XRD) and x-ray absorption fine structure (XAFS) spectroscopy, we investigate the microscopic nature of Cu$^{2+}$/Nb$^{5+}$ disorder on the pseudo-cubic B-sublattice and its relation to the emergent random-singlet (RS) behavior evidenced at low temperatures. While XRD reveals no long-range Cu/Nb ordering and average site occupancy consistent with stoichiometry, XAFS reveals a peculiar local chemical order characterized by preferential heteroatomic Cu$:$Nb correlations. This local arrangement strongly suppresses direct Cu$:$Cu linkages, despite the Cu concentration being close to the percolation threshold of a cubic lattice. The resulting exchange network explains the absence of spin-glass freezing or long-range magnetic order in the presence of substantial antiferromagnetic interactions, as indicated by a Curie-Weiss temperature $Θ_{CW}\approx -50$ K. Instead, the magnetic susceptibility $χ(T)$ and specific heat $c_p(T)$ exhibit power-law behavior and characteristic single-parameter $T/H$ scaling over broad temperature and magnetic-field ranges, consistent with random-singlet phenomenology. Notably, at very low temperatures, the specific heat behavior transitions from $T^{1-γ}$ ($γ\approx 0.6$ from the $T/H$ scaling) in zero-field to a T-linear dependence under high field, indicating a crossover to a distinct low-energy regime whose microscopic origin remains to be established.

AI.tldr: 本文通过同步辐射粉末X射线衍射（XRD）和X射线吸收精细结构谱（XAFS）对ABO₃型无序钙钛矿BaCu₁/₃Nb₂/₃O₃（BCNO）进行了结构和热力学联合研究，揭示了Cu²⁺/Nb⁵⁺在B位上的局域化学有序（偏好异原子Cu:Nb关联）会强烈抑制Cu:Cu直接连接。尽管Cu浓度接近立方晶格渗流阈值，该交换网络仍导致无自旋玻璃冻结或长程磁序，磁化率和比热表现出幂律行为和T/H标度，符合随机单态（random-singlet）现象学。在极低温高场下比热从T^(1-γ)转变为T线性依赖，暗示存在向不同低能态的交叉，其微观起源尚待确定。
AI.motivation: 理解无序钙钛矿中B位Cu²⁺/Nb⁵⁺无序的微观本质及其与低温随机单态行为之间的关联。尽管Cu浓度接近立方晶格渗流阈值，体系却未表现出自旋玻璃冻结或长程磁序，这一反常现象驱动了对局域化学有序的深入探究。
AI.method: 采用同步辐射粉末X射线衍射（XRD）表征长程结构和平均占位；采用X射线吸收精细结构谱（XAFS）探测局域化学环境；结合磁化率χ(T)和比热c_p(T)测量，分析幂律行为和T/H单参数标度以检验随机单态行为。
AI.result: XRD未显示Cu/Nb长程有序且平均占位符合化学计量比；XAFS揭示了偏好异原子Cu:Nb关联的局域化学有序，强烈抑制Cu:Cu直接连接。尽管存在显著反铁磁相互作用（Θ_CW≈-50 K），体系无自旋玻璃或长程磁序。χ(T)和c_p(T)在宽温度和磁场范围内表现出幂律行为及T/H单参数标度，符合随机单态现象。极低温下比热在零场中呈T^(1-γ)（γ≈0.6）行为，高场下转为T线性依赖，表明存在交叉到不同低能态。
AI.conclusion: 局域化学有序在抑制磁有序中起关键作用：即使Cu浓度接近渗流阈值，偏好异原子的局域排列仍有效减少Cu-Cu交换路径，促成随机单态而非自旋玻璃或长程磁序。极低温高场下的T线性比热行为揭示了一个尚未明确的新的低能态，值得进一步研究。

title: Spin-Chirality-Driven Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in van der Waals Magnet CrSBr
summary: The bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) can be greatly enriched in magnetic materials. Here, we establish vector spin chirality as a tunable knob for generating an unconventional time-reversal-even magnetic BPVE, comprising the chiral shift current (CSC) and chiral injection current (CIC). Using bilayer antiferromagnetic (AFM) CrSBr as a prototype, we theoretically demonstrate the emergence of CSC and CIC. Compared with conventional photovoltaic currents arising from noncentrosymmetric crystal structures or collinear magnetic orderings, CSC and CIC not only possess comparable magnitudes but also exhibit exceptional tunability. Specifically, they can be switched on and off by magnetic-field-induced spin canting, reversed in direction upon canting-direction reversal, and continuously modulated in intensity via canting-angle variation. Furthermore, we reveal an unusual optical transition channel governing both currents in CrSBr. Our work establishes an unconventional magnetic BPVE with remarkable controllability, paving the way for applications in optoelectronics and magnetic sensing in noncollinear magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并理论证明了非共线磁性材料中由矢量自旋手性调控的非传统时间反转偶磁体光伏效应，包括手性漂移电流（CSC）和手性注入电流（CIC），以双层反铁磁CrSBr为原型展示了这一效应的产生与巨大可调控性。
AI.motivation: 传统的体光伏效应（BPVE）依赖非中心对称晶体结构或共线磁序，调控手段有限。磁性材料可以丰富BPVE，但如何利用非共线磁结构（特别是矢量自旋手性）作为新的调控自由度来产生和操控光伏电流，尚待探索。
AI.method: 以双层反铁磁CrSBr为原型材料，通过理论计算（结合第一性原理等理论方法）证明矢量自旋手性可以产生两种非常规光伏电流——手性漂移电流（CSC）和手性注入电流（CIC），并系统分析其磁场调控机制。
AI.result: CSC和CIC与传统光伏电流幅度相当，但具有显著优势的可调控性：可通过磁场诱导自旋倾斜实现开关切换，倾斜方向反转可逆转电流方向，倾斜角度变化可连续调制电流强度。此外还揭示了控制这两种电流的非常规光学跃迁通道。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了高度可控的非传统磁体光伏效应，为非共线磁体在光电子学和磁传感领域的应用开辟了新途径。

title: Wavelength-Selective control of Atomic Scale Au Contacts
summary: We demonstrate wavelength-selective control of atomic motion in a mechanically controllable Au break junction. Excitation at $λ_{\mathrm{form}}\simeq 530~{\rm nm}$ drives gap closure and metallic bridge formation, whereas excitation at $λ_{\mathrm{rup}}\simeq 407~{\rm nm}$ drives neck thinning, bridge rupture, and subsequent gap opening. Unlike conventional optical switching in metallic contacts, where illumination primarily acts via thermal expansion, the present experiment reveals oppositely directed atomic drift at different wavelengths. Time-resolved conductance traces allow us to distinguish two dynamical regimes. In the tunneling regime, exponential conductance transients measure the drift velocity of the gap coordinate for both gap closure and gap opening. In the metallic regime, the Sharvin relation converts linear $\sqrt{G/G_0}$ transients into radial neck-growth and neck-thinning velocities of comparable magnitude. These results establish optically selected atomic drift as a mechanism for reversible control of metallic nanocontacts and provide a quantitative route to follow plasmon-assisted atomic rearrangements in real time.
